Properties.description:
The TNSE-5 projects a dense, skin-penetrating field of low-amplitude electromagnetic interference precisely tuned to the conduction velocity range of myelinated peripheral nerve fibers. Targets within the emission cone experience a sudden, total interruption of voluntary motor signals below the neck — the effect is not pain, not unconsciousness, but a clean, terrifying paralysis while the subject remains fully alert. The field does not affect the autonomic nervous system, so breathing and cardiac function continue normally.

The weapon's engineering achievement lies in its frequency-hopping emission architecture, which cycles through seventeen discrete interference bands per second to prevent nerve conduction from adapting or routing around the disruption. Earlier prototypes produced only transient effects as the nervous system compensated within seconds; the TNSE-5's cycling maintains paralysis consistently for the duration of continuous emission plus a residual window of two to four minutes after the field is removed. The emitter cone covers approximately a thirty-degree arc and can be swept across multiple targets.

Arcturus Defense Solutions designed the TNSE-5 for hostage extraction scenarios where a clean, non-lethal area-denial option was required in close proximity to protected personnel. The weapon never entered standard military procurement due to ethical review complications — specifically, the finding that sustained exposure beyond ninety seconds produced measurable long-term nerve conduction deficits in test subjects. Arcturus disputes this finding publicly and continues to sell to private clients under a confidential licensing structure.
Properties.legality: Prohibited (active military licensing exemption for contracted operators)
Properties.specifications:
effective range: 3–18 meters
emission cone: 30 degrees
power source: Modular high-frequency oscillator pack, 9 minutes continuous emission
paralysis onset: 0.3–0.8 seconds
residual effect duration: 2–4 minutes post-emission
weight: 4.4 kg
form factor: Shoulder-braced emitter with pivoting head and integral targeting display
long term risk: Nerve conduction deficit with exposures exceeding 90 seconds (contested by manufacturer)
Properties.tactical_use: Extraction teams use the TNSE-5 to freeze a room while principals are moved — one operator holds the emitter on target while others execute the extraction, then the emitter is withdrawn and the team is clear before the paralysis fades. Counter-kidnapping units favor it for rescues where target identification is uncertain and lethal force is not authorized. The weapon requires a stable firing position and is not suited to mobile engagements. Operators note that aware targets who know the effect is temporary can remain combative immediately upon recovery, requiring secondary restraint measures.
Properties.cultural_context: The TNSE-5 is a weapon of power in a very specific sense: it does not harm, it simply removes agency entirely, and the subject knows it. Among Meridian 88's underground networks, rumors of 'the veil' circulate as a near-mythological threat — something that can take you without a mark, without a sound. Survivors of TNSE-5 deployments frequently report the experience as psychologically scarring in ways that conventional violence is not. The weapon has also found use in a small, disturbing black-market context that authorities have been reluctant to document formally.
Properties.story_hooks: A series of abductions in an upscale district share a common forensic signature — no struggle, no evidence, just missing people — and a medical examiner has quietly flagged the nerve profile.; An Arcturus contractor goes off-reservation with a TNSE-5 unit and the company needs it recovered before the licensing structure is exposed in a criminal investigation.; A survivor of a TNSE-5 deployment is offering significant payment to anyone who can acquire one for a purpose they won't specify.; Arcturus's internal research files on long-term nerve damage are for sale — someone inside the company wants the truth out, but the data is heavily encrypted and the seller is already being followed.

Properties.description:
The TACP-1 delivers a precisely modulated transcutaneous electromagnetic signal that bypasses voluntary motor control entirely by directly stimulating the autonomic and peripheral motor nerve bundles beneath the skin. Unlike weapons that attack the nervous system through pain or disruption, the Puppeteer does not incapacitate — it redirects. A target struck by the beam continues to move, but their movements are dictated by the operator's control interface rather than the target's own intent. The effect is described by victims as 'watching yourself from inside a car you're not driving.' Voluntary motor signals still originate in the target's brain, but the TACP-1's signal overwhelms and overwrites them at the peripheral nerve level.

The weapon requires a secondary control gauntlet worn by the operator, which translates gross motor gestures into the modulation patterns broadcast by the emitter. Control fidelity is imperfect — fine motor tasks like typing or weapon use are beyond the system's resolution — but forcing a target to walk, kneel, strike another person, or step into traffic is well within operational parameters. The psychological trauma of the experience is considered severe; subjects who have been 'puppeted' report lasting dissociative symptoms and profound loss of bodily autonomy. ZHENG-DAO BIOELECTRIC developed the underlying technology for industrial exoskeleton synchronization before the defense application became obvious.

The emitter itself is shoulder-mounted and connected to the control gauntlet by a fiber-optic bundle, allowing the operator freedom of movement while maintaining the beam lock. Maintaining control of a resisting target requires concentration and practice; experienced operators can manage a single target for up to four minutes before signal drift degrades the lock. The weapon has a distinctive high-pitched harmonic emission during operation that street communities have learned to recognize as 'the singing,' and its presence is considered grounds for immediate area evacuation.
Properties.aliases: Puppeteer, The Stringbox, Twitch Gun, TACP
Properties.legality: Prohibited — classified as a bodily autonomy violation weapon under Meridian 88 Statute 12.7 ('The Vessel Laws')
Properties.specifications:
effective range: 3–40 meters (beam lock required)
control fidelity: Gross motor only — walking, posture, large limb movements
maximum control duration: 4 minutes per charge cycle before signal drift
simultaneous targets: 1 (experimental multi-target variants exist, unstable)
power source: Dual-cell autonomic modulation array, 6 full control cycles
emitter weight: 2.8 kg (shoulder mount)
gauntlet weight: 0.9 kg
harmonic emission: Audible at 11–13 kHz within 15 meters of emitter
known countermeasures: Faraday-lined undersuit (partial), neural shielding implants (effective)
Properties.tactical_use: Used for hostage extraction scenarios where the target must be moved without alerting them, for forcing a target to perform actions that implicate them (signing documents, committing acts on camera), and for using a target as a human shield. Covert intelligence operations have used it to walk an asset through a facility without the asset's knowledge, extracting them while maintaining the appearance of voluntary movement. Combat applications are limited by the concentration required — operators are vulnerable while maintaining control — but it has been used to force armed targets to discharge their weapons in controlled directions.
Properties.cultural_context: The Puppeteer occupies a unique position of cultural horror in Meridian 88. The city's population already lives with significant anxieties about bodily autonomy — neural implants, corporate behavioral modification, pharmaceutical control — and the TACP-1 literalizes those fears. 'Puppeted' has become a broader cultural term for anyone perceived to be acting under external control, whether corporate, pharmaceutical, or technological. Victim advocacy groups have pushed aggressively for the Vessel Laws that prohibit the weapon, and there is an organized underground network that helps survivors access psychological care. Possessing a Puppeteer marks the bearer as willing to cross a line that even hardened street operators often consider absolute.
Properties.story_hooks: A city council member was captured on surveillance footage committing a violent act — but a witness claims they saw 'the singing' in the corridor beforehand. The party must prove the footage shows a Puppeteer operation before the member is executed.; A TACP-1 control gauntlet is found in a safehouse with recorded gesture logs — playing back the logs means experiencing exactly what someone forced another person to do. The party must decide whether to use the evidence and expose the victim's experience publicly.; ZHENG-DAO BIOELECTRIC is quietly approaching Vessel Law legislators with 'legitimate medical applications' — the party learns that three of the four key dissenting votes have recently begun behaving strangely in public.; A character wakes up with muscle soreness consistent with hours of activity they don't remember. Someone has been borrowing their body while they sleep.

Properties.description:
The TMGRC-4 generates a precisely shaped galvanic pulse in the low-frequency acoustic range, tuned to induce maximum mechanical stress across the tympanic membrane. Unlike blunt acoustic weapons that rely on overpressure, the Puncture exploits the specific resonant behavior of the eardrum's layered mucosal, fibrous, and epithelial structure — the galvanic coupling causes differential expansion between layers, tearing the membrane from the inside out without requiring sufficient volume to damage surrounding tissue. The result is immediate, complete bilateral perforation at ranges up to fifty meters.

The injury profile is distinctive: targets experience instantaneous total hearing loss, severe tinnitus, acute vertigo from disruption of the middle ear ossicular chain, and intense pain. The vertigo component is particularly tactically significant — targets are rendered unable to stand or orient themselves for several minutes regardless of pain tolerance or training. Unlike pressure-wave eardrum rupture, the galvanic mechanism causes a clean perforation pattern that is slower to heal and more prone to infection, with many victims sustaining permanent partial hearing loss even with treatment.

Tessera Corponation developed the TMGRC-4 under a civil security contract as a 'precision acoustic compliance tool,' emphasizing its ability to incapacitate individuals within a crowd without affecting bystanders beyond a narrow beam. Field operators nicknamed it Puncture within weeks of deployment. The carbine form factor, relatively light weight, and long effective range made it a preferred tool for Tessera's own internal security apparatus, where it is used to manage dissenting employees and labor organizers with a minimum of visible injury.
Properties.specifications:
effective range: 3–50 meters
beam divergence: 2.1° (highly directional)
frequency range: Adaptive sweep, 800 Hz–3.4 kHz galvanic-coupled
pulse duration: 0.08 seconds for full perforation
magazine: Capacitor bank, 30 shots per charge
weight: 1.9 kg
hearing protection countermeasure: Standard ear protection provides no defense (galvanic rather than pressure mechanism)
Properties.tactical_use: The TMGRC-4 is typically used for crowd control and targeted incapacitation in enclosed or semi-enclosed environments where collateral damage must be minimized. Operators exploit the vertigo component to drop targets before moving in for physical restraint. A noted tactical advantage is that standard hearing protection — commonly worn by security-aware targets — provides zero defense against the galvanic mechanism, making it effective against prepared opponents. In assassination contexts, a Puncture shot is sometimes used to disorient before a follow-up conventional weapon.
Properties.cultural_context: Within Tessera Corponation's vast internal culture, being 'punctured' has become corporate shorthand for being silenced or neutralized professionally — the linguistic parallel to the weapon's literal effect is not lost on employees. Workers in Tessera's lower tiers are acutely aware that the carbines carried by internal security are not visible deterrents but active instruments of compliance. In the wider city, the TMGRC-4's reputation rests heavily on the fact that it leaves no mark — dismissed workers who return from 'compliance sessions' with hearing damage have no visible injuries to present as evidence.
Properties.story_hooks: A labor organizer inside Tessera Corponation is documenting the systematic use of the TMGRC-4 on workers — she's lost most of her hearing and needs someone to get her documentation out of a secure internal network.; A shipment of TMGRC-4 units with the corporate serial numbers ground off appears in an Outerring arms market — tracking the supply chain leads somewhere no one expected.; A fixer known for wearing military-grade hearing protection is found incapacitated with bilateral perforations — someone with access to a Puncture wanted them stopped, and the players need to find out who.; Tessera Corponation quietly approaches the players to recover a stolen TMGRC-4 technical manual before a competitor can reverse-engineer the galvanic coupling mechanism.

Properties.description:
The VIR-9 is a linear magnetically accelerated rifle that distinguishes itself through its real-time impedance modulation system. Conventional gauss rifles fix their magnetic coil parameters at manufacture, producing a consistent velocity and terminal profile. The Switchback instead allows the operator to adjust coil impedance across a 12-stage spectrum between shots, changing the projectile's exit velocity, spin rate, and electromagnetic emission profile on the fly. A low-impedance shot exits at subsonic velocity with minimal EM signature, functioning as a near-silent precision round. Maximum impedance produces a hypervelocity dart capable of defeating most structural barriers short of military-grade composite plating.

Tessera Corponation developed the VIR-9 for private security forces that operate across highly variable threat environments where carrying multiple weapon systems is impractical. The 12-stage impedance selector is mounted as a rotating collar around the trigger guard, operable with the firing hand without breaking grip — a deliberate ergonomic priority that took four design iterations to achieve. The rifle feeds from a 15-round magazine of ferromagnetic tungsten darts, each identical; the variation in terminal effect is produced entirely by the electromagnetic system rather than by different projectile types.

The weapon's primary limitation is thermal management. Running sustained fire at high-impedance settings causes the coil array to overheat, and the VIR-9 includes an automatic throttle that forces a 4-second cooling interval after three consecutive maximum-impedance shots. Operators who try to bypass this limiter have destroyed the coil array, rendering the weapon inert. The black market offers bypass chips, but their reliability is disputed and their installation voids what little warranty the weapon carries.
Properties.specifications:
projectile: 3.2mm ferromagnetic tungsten dart
impedance stages: 12 selectable stages (subsonic to hypervelocity)
effective range: 40m (low impedance) / 600m (maximum impedance)
rate of fire: Semi-automatic
weight: 3.4 kg loaded
magazine capacity: 15 darts
thermal throttle: Forced 4-second cooling after 3 consecutive max-impedance shots
sound signature: Variable — near-silent at Stage 1, loud crack at Stage 12
power source: Integrated coil battery, 90 shots per charge at mixed impedance
Properties.tactical_use: Operators train with the VIR-9 across its full impedance range, developing the muscle memory to adjust the collar selector instinctively. Standard engagement doctrine opens at low impedance for target acquisition and confirmation, then adjusts upward based on the target's apparent armor profile. In urban environments, the ability to reduce sound signature dramatically without swapping weapons makes the VIR-9 extremely valuable for mobile operations. Military users value it for the flexibility it provides in asymmetric engagements where threat profiles change rapidly.
Properties.cultural_context: The VIR-9 is associated with serious professional operators who can afford expensive, complex equipment and have the training to use it effectively. It is not a weapon for the desperate or the untrained — the impedance selector is useless without proper calibration knowledge, and an operator who doesn't understand the thermal throttle will find themselves with a cooling rifle at exactly the wrong moment. Among Tessera Corponation's private security divisions, carrying a VIR-9 is a mark of senior field status. On the open market, its restricted classification means legitimate purchasers are vetted; black market copies often have degraded coil arrays from overuse.
Properties.story_hooks: A forensic investigator has recovered dart fragments from three separate crime scenes across different districts. The EM burn signature on each fragment indicates the same VIR-9 unit was used at each location — but the scenes span six weeks and the targets have no obvious connection. Someone is using a Switchback to work through a list, and no one knows whose list it is.; Tessera Corponation has quietly recalled a batch of VIR-9 units — serial numbers 9400 through 9650 — citing a 'coil calibration anomaly.' The recall notice went only to licensed retailers. The actual problem is that this batch was manufactured with a firmware error that causes the impedance selector to randomly spike to Stage 12 regardless of setting. Two operators have already been killed by the recoil. Tessera wants the units back before this becomes public.; A player acquires a VIR-9 and discovers its serial number has been filed down — but the coil battery's charge log still contains usage records from 47 previous engagements. Someone used this weapon extensively and then wanted it to disappear. The usage timestamps and impedance profiles tell a story if someone knows how to read them.

Properties.description:
The VREC-4 operates on the principle of targeted ultrasonic cavitation applied to the circulatory system. The weapon projects a focused beam of high-intensity focused ultrasound (HIFU) tuned to induce cavitation specifically within large-vessel blood flow — the carotid arteries, femoral veins, and pulmonary vasculature are primary targets. Cavitation at these sites generates localized microbubble formation within the bloodstream; when these bubbles collapse, they produce platelet activation cascades that trigger rapid, localized thrombus formation. In practical terms: the weapon causes strokes and pulmonary emboli on demand, at range, through clothing and light cover.

The Clotter's clinical presentation is its most insidious feature. A target struck in the carotid corridor presents within 30–120 seconds with symptoms indistinguishable from spontaneous ischemic stroke — sudden confusion, facial drooping, loss of arm control, speech disruption. Without the operator's knowledge, a forensic pathologist examining the victim would find a thrombus consistent with natural coagulation pathology. This deniability has made the VREC-4 the preferred weapon of a specific class of operator: those who need deaths that survive insurance review, inheritance challenges, and criminal investigation. TESSERA CORPONATION originally developed the HIFU platform for non-invasive cardiac surgery assistance; the coagulation application was a noted risk in their own safety literature, which was later cited by RINGO CORPONATION engineers who developed the weaponized variant.

The carbine form factor is deliberate — the weapon is designed to pass casual inspection as a conventional semi-automatic carbine with an unusual muzzle configuration. The beam is silent, invisible, and produces no thermal signature detectable by standard security scanning. Its only detectable emission is a narrow ultrasonic band that requires specialized equipment to identify. Operators carry a small transducer wand as a secondary tool for confirming vessel targeting through walls — a practice called 'fishing' in professional circles.
Properties.manufacturer: RINGO CORPONATION (derived from TESSERA CORPONATION medical platform)
Properties.legality: Prohibited — classified as a method of undetectable homicide
Properties.specifications:
effective range: 5–80 meters
penetration: Effective through clothing, 4 cm soft tissue, light drywall
targeting corridor: Carotid (stroke), femoral (DVT/PE), pulmonary (embolism)
time to thrombus formation: 15–45 seconds post-strike
time to clinical presentation: 30–120 seconds
forensic detectability: None with standard autopsy — requires specialized HIFU exposure testing
power source: Ultrasonic transducer cell, 22 discharges
weight: 3.1 kg
length: 68 cm
secondary tool: Vessel-targeting transducer wand (included)
detectable emission: Narrow ultrasonic band, requires specialized scanner
Properties.tactical_use: Used almost exclusively in assassination and targeted removal operations where forensic deniability is the primary requirement. Operators typically use the transducer wand to locate the target's major vessels through walls or from concealment before firing. The weapon is rarely used in open combat — its slow effect onset makes it unsuitable against alert targets. It is most effective against stationary or unaware targets in controlled environments. Some operators combine it with a conventional weapon as a backup, using the Clotter first to degrade the target's neurological function and then following up if the coagulation effect is insufficient.
Properties.cultural_context: The Clotter is known in Meridian 88's professional assassination community as the 'accountant's weapon' — clean, deniable, and expensive. It is almost never seen at street level. Its existence is an open secret among corporate legal and security teams, who know that a sudden cluster of 'natural' deaths among executives or board members warrants investigation for VREC use. TESSERA CORPONATION has aggressively distanced itself from the weapon's existence despite its technology forming the platform's core, and has funded at least two bounties on RINGO CORPONATION engineers involved in the weaponization project. The weapon has contributed to a broader cultural paranoia in Meridian 88's upper corporate tiers — the wealthy have begun investing heavily in private medical staff trained to identify VREC presentations, and 'clot insurance' (rapid-response emergency medical contracts with specific HIFU testing protocols) has become a significant industry.
Properties.story_hooks: A wave of 'natural' deaths among mid-tier TESSERA CORPONATION executives is being quietly investigated internally — the party is hired to find the operator before the investigation becomes public and tanks the stock price. The trail leads somewhere unexpected.; A forensic pathologist has developed a post-mortem test that can detect VREC-caused thrombi — she is now a target, and the party must decide whether to protect her or broker her safety in exchange for information about who hired the shooter.; A character is struck by a Clotter round in a crowd but survives due to an unusual coagulation disorder. They experienced the full pre-stroke aura and know someone tried to kill them — but there's no evidence, no wound, and no witness.; RINGO CORPONATION is quietly offering a licensing deal to a municipal police department — the VREC-4 as a 'non-lethal compliance tool' with 'tuned-down' settings. Someone needs to stop this before it gets a veneer of legality.

Vespid Dynamics Adhesive Restraint Launcher ARL-2 'Flypaper'

Properties.description: A launcher that fires capsules of Vespid's industrial-strength cyanoacrylate adhesive compound, which upon impact splatters over a 2-meter radius and bonds to any surface with approximately 800 kg/m² shear strength within 4 seconds of air exposure. Targets struck by the adhesive are effectively glued in place — hands bonded to weapons, feet to floors, bodies to walls. The compound is resistant to solvents and requires a proprietary debonding agent that Vespid sells separately, creating a capture-and-control dynamic where the restraining party controls the only means of release.

Properties.legality: Licensed — law enforcement and industrial restraint

magazine: 4 capsules

adhesive cure time: 4 seconds to full bond
adhesive persistence: Indefinite without debonding agent
Properties.story_hooks: A group of people were found adhesive-bonded to the exterior of a corporate building as a protest display — alive, unharmed, but immovable without Vespid debonding agent that the protesters refuse to provide.; Someone has been Flypapering the doors of Tier 3 apartment buildings shut, trapping residents inside — the debonding agent is being withheld until payment is made.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Corrosive Launcher CL-3 'Acid Reign'

Properties.description: A grenade-launcher-format weapon that fires encapsulated payloads of binary corrosive compound. Each round contains two separated chemical chambers that mix upon impact, creating a highly exothermic acid reaction that dissolves most metals, polymers, and organic materials within a 2-meter splash radius. The binary design means the individual components are relatively safe to handle and store — the danger only manifests on impact mixing. Vespid developed it for rapid structural demolition, but its anti-vehicle and anti-personnel applications have dominated field use.
Properties.aliases: Acid Reign, CL-3, Spit Launcher, The Melter

corrosion rate: 3mm structural steel per minute
effective range: 30-100 meters
weight: 3.5 kg
neutralization time: Compound becomes inert after 8 minutes
Properties.story_hooks: A building's structural supports were pre-weakened with CL-3 acid rounds days before a scheduled demolition — someone ensured the building would collapse ahead of schedule, with people still inside.; A modified CL-3 round has been developed that produces a corrosive gas rather than liquid — turning it from a point weapon into an area denial tool.

Properties.description: A compact flechette pistol that fires salvos of micro-darts from a rotating drum magazine. Each dart carries a piezoelectric charge that discharges on penetration, causing involuntary muscle contraction around the wound channel. Vespid markets it as a 'compliance sidearm' but field reports document fatalities from cardiac disruption when dart clusters strike the thorax.

Properties.story_hooks: A batch of NS-4 darts has surfaced with a neurotoxin coating not listed in any Vespid catalog — someone is weaponizing the platform beyond spec.; A clinic in the lower tiers is overwhelmed with patients showing identical flechette wound patterns — someone is using Pincushions for systematic intimidation.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Neural Feedback Dart NFD-2 'Scream'

Properties.description: A pneumatic dart weapon that delivers a neural interface exploit payload on penetration, hijacking the target's pain processing and amplifying all sensory input to maximum intensity. The victim experiences every sensation — light, sound, touch, temperature — as agonizing pain for approximately 2 minutes. The dart carries a micro-transmitter that injects the exploit through the wound channel into any nearby neural interface hardware. Against unaugmented targets, the dart is merely a sharp object. Against augmented targets, it is a precision agony weapon.
Properties.aliases: Scream, NFD-2, Pain Dart, Feedback Shot

Properties.story_hooks: An NFD-2 dart was used during an interrogation — the 2-minute pain cycle broke the subject's resistance permanently, and they now experience phantom pain episodes triggered by any strong sensation.; Modified NFD-2 darts have appeared that deliver a pleasure amplification exploit instead of pain — the resulting euphoria is so intense that victims become addicted to being shot.

Properties.description: A micro-drone the size of a large insect that autonomously navigates to a target's head and delivers a neural disruption payload through a penetrating proboscis. The NH-1 uses thermal and pheromone tracking to identify and approach a specific individual, then lands on exposed skin — typically the neck or behind the ear — and inserts a 2mm probe that delivers a concentrated electromagnetic pulse directly to the neural interface hardware. The target experiences immediate sensory overload, disorientation, and temporary loss of motor control. The drone then self-destructs, leaving minimal forensic evidence. Vespid does not acknowledge the NH-1's existence in any product catalog.
Properties.aliases: Brainbug, NH-1, Neural Wasp, The Crawler
Properties.legality: Does not officially exist — no legal classification

Properties.story_hooks: A corporate executive collapsed during a public speech with symptoms consistent with neural interface overload — a dead insect-sized drone was found crushed on their collar.; Someone has obtained NH-1 pheromone tracking data and is selling target-locked drones to anyone with the money — assassination as a subscription service.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Paralytic Aerosol Grenade PAG-2 'Sleepy Time'

Properties.description: A throwable aerosol grenade that disperses Vespid's proprietary fast-acting paralytic compound over a 10-meter radius. The compound targets voluntary motor function while leaving autonomic systems intact — targets remain conscious and breathing but cannot move, speak, or resist for approximately fifteen minutes. The effect onset is 3-5 seconds after inhalation, making the window for donning respiratory protection extremely narrow. Vespid markets it as a humane incapacitation tool, though the psychological effect of being fully conscious but completely paralyzed has been documented as severely traumatic.

Properties.story_hooks: PAG-2 grenades have been deployed in a series of robberies targeting augmented individuals — victims are paralyzed while their cyberware is surgically removed.; A contaminated batch of PAG-2 grenades has hit the market where the autonomic preservation fails in approximately 5% of exposures — meaning some victims stop breathing.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Paralytic Wasp Drone PWD-4 'Yellowjacket'

Properties.description: A small quad-rotor drone the size of a fist, painted in Vespid's characteristic yellow-and-black livery, equipped with a retractable syringe containing a paralytic compound. The Yellowjacket autonomously navigates to a designated target, matches their pace, and delivers a single injection — typically to the neck or exposed limb — before returning to its launch point for reload. The paralytic compound immobilizes the target for 15-20 minutes while leaving them fully conscious and aware. The drone's small size and quiet electric motors make it difficult to detect in urban environments, and its yellow-black coloring is both a brand statement and a psychological weapon — in Meridian 88, seeing anything yellow and black with rotors means Vespid is watching.

Properties.story_hooks: A string of muggings involve victims being paralyzed by Yellowjacket stings before being robbed — the drones are stolen Vespid units but the paralytic compound is custom-made.; A Yellowjacket loaded with a lethal compound instead of paralytic was deployed in a corporate office — the target died at their desk and the drone returned to its operator before anyone noticed.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Pheromone Marker Gun PMG-1 'Breadwinner'

Properties.description: A pistol-format weapon that fires capsules of synthetic pheromone compound that mark a target with an invisible chemical signature detectable by Vespid's autonomous drone platforms. A target marked by the PMG-1 becomes a beacon — every Vespid drone within detection range will identify them as a designated target, enabling autonomous tracking and engagement. The pheromone compound bonds to clothing, skin, and hair, and cannot be washed off with standard solvents — it must be neutralized with a UV exposure protocol that itself takes 30 minutes of sustained treatment. The weapon does no damage itself; it simply paints a target for everything else in Vespid's arsenal.
Properties.aliases: Breadwinner, PMG-1, Scent Gun, The Marker
Properties.specifications:
capsule type: Synthetic pheromone marker compound
effective range: 5-25 meters
marking duration: 48 hours on skin, 72 hours on clothing
detection range: Vespid drone platforms detect at 500+ meters
neutralization: 30-minute UV exposure protocol
magazine: 8 capsules
weight: 0.7 kg
compound visibility: Invisible to naked eye, fluoresces under UV
Properties.story_hooks: A player character has been marked with a PMG-1 pheromone compound and Vespid drones are converging on their location — they have 48 hours to find a UV neutralization source or go underground.; Someone has obtained PMG-1 compound and is spraying it on random people in crowded areas, triggering Vespid drone responses against innocent civilians — it is creating chaos and nobody knows who is doing it.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Shrike Autonomous Turret SAT-2

Properties.description: A compact autonomous turret platform weighing 8 kg that can be deployed on any stable surface and left to provide automated fire support. The SAT-2 uses a combination of thermal, optical, and acoustic sensors to detect and engage targets within its programmed rules of engagement. It fires 5.56mm caseless ammunition from a 200-round internal hopper at a rate sufficient for suppressive or precision fire. The turret's AI can distinguish between armed and unarmed personnel, moving vehicles and pedestrians, and can be programmed to hold fire on targets matching specific biometric profiles. Vespid markets it as a 'force multiplier for undermanned positions.'
Properties.legality: Licensed — military and authorized perimeter defense
Properties.specifications:
caliber: 5.56mm caseless
hopper capacity: 200 rounds
rate of fire: 300 RPM suppressive, semi-auto precision
sensor suite: Thermal + optical + acoustic triangulation
engagement range: 10-150 meters
weight: 8 kg
setup time: 15 seconds
battery life: 72 hours standby, 6 hours active scanning
traverse: 270 degrees horizontal, 45 degrees vertical
Properties.story_hooks: A SAT-2 deployed in a Tier 2 commercial district opened fire on unarmed civilians — the target discrimination AI was updated with a firmware patch from an unknown source 12 hours prior.; Someone has been deploying SAT-2 turrets in the undercity with their IFF systems set to engage anyone with corporate security biometric signatures — the turrets are protecting territory that nobody has claimed.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Spore Cloud Disperser SCD-1 'Bloom'

Properties.description: A backpack-mounted dispersal system that releases clouds of engineered fungal spores designed to colonize and degrade specific material types. Different spore payloads target different substrates — one variant consumes synthetic polymers, another attacks ferrous metals, a third breaks down carbon-fiber composites. The spores germinate on contact with their target material and begin enzymatic degradation within hours, visibly consuming equipment, armor, vehicles, and infrastructure over a period of 2-5 days. Vespid developed the system for environmental remediation of industrial waste sites, but its application as a slow-acting area denial and equipment destruction weapon has not escaped military planners.
Properties.aliases: Bloom, SCD-1, Spore Gun, Mushroom Cloud
Properties.legality: Licensed — environmental remediation; Prohibited — all other use
Properties.specifications:
dispersal method: Backpack-mounted pressurized aerosol
cloud radius: 15-meter deployment zone per burst
spore germination: 2-6 hours on target substrate
full material degradation: 2-5 days depending on substrate
payload types: Polymer-consuming, ferrous metal-consuming, carbon composite-consuming
reservoir: 10 deployment bursts per tank
weight: 8 kg loaded
countermeasure: UV sterilization within 4 hours of exposure halts colonization
Properties.story_hooks: A Tier 3 armory's entire weapons stockpile was rendered useless overnight — polymer-consuming spores were introduced through the ventilation system, eating every synthetic component in the building.; Spore payloads designed to consume human-compatible biomedical polymers have been detected — if deployed, they would attack cybernetic implant housings inside living people.

Properties.description: A launchable canister containing twelve autonomous micro-drones, each roughly the size of a human thumb, equipped with a shaped-charge warhead capable of defeating light armor. Once deployed, the swarm uses collective optical tracking to identify and converge on a designated target type — personnel, vehicles, or electronics. The drones communicate via ultrasonic chirps that give the swarm its characteristic insectoid sound. Individual drones are easily destroyed, but the swarm's distributed targeting means eliminating all twelve before detonation is statistically improbable.
Properties.aliases: Hornets, Bug Bomb, SC-2, The Hive
Properties.specifications:
drone count: 12 per canister
warhead: 2g shaped copper charge per drone
swarm radius: 40 meter engagement envelope
flight time: 90 seconds per drone
target acquisition: Collective optical + ultrasonic coordination
weight: 1.8 kg per canister
launch method: Pneumatic tube launcher or hand-thrown
Properties.story_hooks: A swarm canister detonated in a crowded market — but the drones only targeted people with a specific model of cranial implant, suggesting the targeting firmware has been modified.; Vespid's insurance division is quietly settling claims from a friendly-fire incident where an SC-2 swarm misidentified allied security forces as hostiles.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Swarm Intelligence Mine SIM-2 'Anthill'

Properties.description: A buried anti-personnel mine that, when triggered, launches a swarm of six micro-drones rather than detonating a conventional explosive. The micro-drones emerge from the mine casing, acquire the triggering target using thermal and motion tracking, and pursue it at high speed before detonating their individual shaped charges on contact. The SIM-2 combines the area denial function of a mine with the target-tracking capability of a guided weapon — it cannot be outrun, and it pursues targets who would normally survive by stepping off a conventional mine's pressure plate. Vespid markets it as a 'persistent area denial system with target discrimination.'
Properties.aliases: Anthill, SIM-2, Smart Mine, Bug Trap
Properties.specifications:
trigger: Seismic/pressure activation with thermal confirmation
drone count: 6 pursuit micro-drones per mine
individual warhead: 5g shaped charge
pursuit speed: 60 km/h
pursuit range: 200 meters from mine location
flight time: 30 seconds per drone
mine dimensions: 15 cm diameter, 8 cm height
burial depth: 5-10 cm
weight: 1.5 kg per mine
Properties.story_hooks: A hiking trail has been seeded with SIM-2 mines and three hikers have been killed by pursuit drones — the mines were planted months ago and the trail has been in use the entire time.; A SIM-2 mine malfunctioned and launched its drones without a target — the six micro-drones are now circling a Tier 2 intersection, armed and seeking anything that moves.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Toxin Dart Rifle TDR-3 'Asp'

Properties.description: A suppressed pneumatic rifle firing hollow-point darts loaded with selectable toxin payloads. The TDR-3 operates on compressed gas propulsion, producing no muzzle flash and minimal acoustic signature — the loudest component is the dart's impact. Vespid supplies a range of toxin capsules from incapacitant to lethal, color-coded and loaded into the dart's reservoir chamber before firing. The weapon has become the preferred tool of corporate assassination teams who need deniable, quiet elimination at medium range.
Properties.aliases: Asp, TDR-3, Venom Rifle, Quiet Death
Properties.specifications:
propulsion: Compressed nitrogen, 180 m/s dart velocity
effective range: 15-80 meters
magazine: 5-dart rotary chamber
acoustic signature: 38 dB at 1 meter
toxin options: Incapacitant (blue), paralytic (yellow), lethal (red), tracer compound (green)
weight: 2.8 kg with optic
optics: Integrated 4x thermal with wind compensation
Properties.story_hooks: A series of apparently natural deaths among mid-tier corporate managers has been linked by a single commonality — trace compounds consistent with TDR-3 green tracer darts found in their bloodwork.; A Vespid insider is selling a new toxin capsule on the black market that induces permanent memory loss of the preceding 72 hours — perfect for witnesses.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Tracker Round System TRS-4 'Breadcrumb'

Properties.description: A modified rifle system that fires rounds containing a micro-transmitter that embeds in the target on impact and broadcasts location data for up to 72 hours. The TRS-4 round is a low-velocity subsonic projectile designed to penetrate clothing and embed in subcutaneous tissue without causing significant injury — the goal is tagging, not killing. The embedded transmitter is smaller than a grain of rice and broadcasts on a frequency detectable by Vespid's proprietary tracking receivers at ranges up to 5 kilometers. The round's low velocity means it feels like a hard punch rather than a gunshot, and many targets do not realize they have been tagged until the transmitter is discovered during medical examination.
Properties.aliases: Breadcrumb, TRS-4, Tracker Bullet, Tag Round
Properties.specifications:
caliber: 8mm subsonic tracker round
muzzle velocity: 90 m/s — subcutaneous embedding velocity
effective range: 10-40 meters
transmitter size: 2mm x 1mm micro-chip
broadcast duration: 72 hours
tracking range: 5 kilometers with Vespid receiver
magazine: 6 rounds
weight: 2.5 kg rifle
injury profile: Minimal — subcutaneous embedding with bruising
Properties.story_hooks: A player character discovers a micro-transmitter embedded in their shoulder that they do not remember receiving — someone tagged them with a TRS-4 and has been tracking their movements for days.; A modified TRS-4 round has been developed that delivers a micro-dose of sedative along with the transmitter — targets fall asleep within minutes and wake up tagged.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Venomfly Micro-Drone Swarm VMS-3 'Murder Cloud'

Properties.description: An advanced evolution of Vespid's micro-drone platform, the VMS-3 deploys a cloud of 50 insect-sized drones that collectively form a mobile toxic fog. Each drone carries a micro-reservoir of contact neurotoxin that it disperses through ultrasonic atomization while flying in a coordinated swarm pattern. The cloud of drones and toxin droplets moves as a coherent mass toward designated coordinates, flowing around obstacles and through openings as small as a ventilation grate. The swarm's collective intelligence allows it to pursue moving targets, avoid countermeasures, and saturate enclosed spaces. Individual drones have only 4 minutes of flight time, but the swarm staggers activation to maintain the cloud for up to 10 minutes.
Properties.aliases: Murder Cloud, VMS-3, Venom Swarm, Flycloud
Properties.specifications:
drone count: 50 per deployment canister
individual drone size: 1.5 cm wingspan
swarm cloud diameter: 3-8 meters
flight time: 4 minutes per drone, 10 minutes staggered swarm
toxin: Contact neurotoxin, incapacitation in 15 seconds of skin exposure
operating range: 300 meters from launch
navigation: Collective AI with coordinate targeting
weight: 2.5 kg per deployment canister
Properties.story_hooks: A Murder Cloud was deployed in a sealed corporate boardroom during a shareholder meeting — the attack was precise, premeditated, and someone had detailed knowledge of the building's ventilation layout.; A VMS-3 swarm was intercepted mid-flight and its navigation data extracted — the coordinates lead to a target who has no idea they were marked for assassination.

Properties.description:
The VSB-4 is a single-edged blade approximately 38cm in length, constructed from layered titanium-carbide composite and threaded internally with a dense lattice of piezoelectric actuator filaments. When activated, the blade oscillates at frequencies between 28,000 and 54,000 Hz, cycling through resonance harmonics that allow the cutting edge to part most commercial-grade armor plating with minimal applied force. The oscillation cycle is managed by a thumb-toggle on the ergonomic polymer grip, with three preset frequency profiles selectable mid-engagement.

What distinguishes the VSB-4 from earlier vibronic blades is its harmonic stepping algorithm, which prevents the blade from settling into a single resonance frequency long enough to be countered by adaptive dampening systems embedded in high-end armor. Older vibronic weapons were rendered largely ineffective against Tier 4 and above protective gear by the mid-2070s; the VSB-4's frequency cycling reestablished melee relevance in close-quarters engagements against hardened targets.

The blade produces a faint, tooth-aching hum audible within roughly two meters of the wielder, which experienced operators consider a psychological asset. The sound has become culturally associated with professional violence in Meridian 88's lower districts, and the mere activation click of a VSB-4 in a confined space has been documented as sufficient to de-escalate confrontations without further action.
Properties.specifications:
blade length: 38cm
total length: 52cm
weight: 680g
frequency range: 28,000–54,000 Hz
frequency profiles: 3
power source: Integrated graphene microcell, 4-hour continuous operation
blade material: Titanium-carbide composite with piezoelectric filament lattice
grip material: Shock-dampening polymer with tactile frequency indicator
Properties.tactical_use: Operators typically keep the blade deactivated until the moment of commitment to avoid audio detection. In tight corridors and vehicle interiors, the VSB-4 is favored over firearms due to its penetration of light-to-medium armor without ricochet risk. Enforcers use it in interrogation-adjacent contexts where the activation sound alone communicates intent. Frequency profile 3 is reserved for hardened exosuit seams and joint gaps.
Properties.cultural_context: The VSB-4 occupies an uncomfortable middle space in Meridian 88's weapon culture — too sophisticated for common street carry, too visceral for corporate operatives who prefer cleaner tools. It is strongly associated with mid-tier fixers, debt collectors working for biotech creditors, and the personal security details of black-market surgeons. Owning one signals a professional who works close and expects resistance. In the Underbelly districts, the nickname 'The Dentist' reflects a dark humor about the kind of precision pain it implies.
Properties.story_hooks: A VSB-4 is recovered from a crime scene with its frequency log intact — the harmonic stepping pattern has been custom-programmed to match a specific proprietary armor system, suggesting the murder was highly premeditated and technically sophisticated.; ARCTURUS Defense Solutions is quietly recalling a batch of VSB-4 units due to a firmware flaw that causes the harmonic stepper to lock into a frequency that resonates destructively with certain neural implant housings — but they haven't gone public, and the affected units are still in circulation.; A street medic in the Underbelly trades information for protection, and her sole protector carries a VSB-4 whose activation sound has become a local warning signal — when people hear it, they clear the street. Someone wants to silence both of them.

Nodes.Name: Former military close-quarters specialists operating privately

Properties.description:
The VACC-6 is a delayed-action area weapon that operates through catalytic aerosol chemistry rather than conventional explosive mechanics. The device releases a proprietary suspended catalyst compound — developed under LAZARUS PHARMACEUTICALS' advanced biochemical division — that remains inert in open air but undergoes rapid exothermic oxidation when it contacts the compressed, humidified air of sealed respiratory systems: lungs, rebreathers, HVAC circulation loops, and sealed habitat environments. The resulting reaction is not a traditional explosion but a localized chemical combustion event occurring at the point of inhalation or intake, typically producing severe internal thermal trauma and toxic oxidation byproducts simultaneously.

The tactical novelty of the VACC-6 is its discrimination logic: the catalytic compound is essentially harmless in ambient atmospheric conditions but becomes a precision incendiary the moment it enters a system designed to concentrate and circulate air. This makes it extraordinarily effective in environments where conventional explosives cannot be used — pressurized habitats, clean-room facilities, medical bays, and sealed transport vehicles. Targets wearing open-face armor survive unharmed while those in sealed suit systems suffer catastrophic respiratory failure. The compound disperses to safe concentrations within 90 minutes in open environments.

LAZARUS PHARMACEUTICALS has consistently denied that the VACC-6 was developed as a weapons system, characterizing the catalytic compound as a derivative of their atmospheric remediation research. Internal documents recovered by investigative journalists suggest otherwise. The weapon is called 'Breathseed' by operators because of the delay between dispersal and effect — you plant it in the air, and it grows when someone breathes.
Properties.specifications:
dispersal radius: 12m initial cloud
activation condition: Contact with compressed/humidified respiratory airflow
reaction temperature: 600–900°C at point of contact
atmospheric persistence: 90 minutes at standard conditions
compound state: Suspended nano-droplet aerosol
delivery form: Pressurized canister, 380g
weight: 0.6 kg
safe handling: Open-air deployment only; deploying operator must use open-face respirator, not sealed system
detection: Requires specialized spectrographic analysis; invisible, odorless
Properties.tactical_use: Used for covert facility denial — deployed in HVAC intake points, airlock staging areas, and pressurized vehicle garages before target arrival. Particularly effective against sealed-suit security teams and environmental control personnel who rely on closed-loop air systems. Assassination applications involve trace dispersal in enclosed vehicles or private habitat spaces. The 90-minute dissipation window allows operators to be long clear of the site before effects manifest, providing deniability. Counter-use: targets who detect the compound via spectrographic scan have a brief window to purge affected systems.
Properties.cultural_context: The VACC-6 is one of the most controversial weapons in Meridian 88's black market ecosystem because of its perceived 'invisibility' — it leaves no blast signature, no shrapnel, no obvious crime scene. LAZARUS PHARMACEUTICALS' corporate reputation has been shadowed by persistent rumors of its involvement in several high-profile sealed-facility deaths, none of which have been conclusively prosecuted. Among covert operators, Breathseed is considered a mark of serious professional resources — it is not a weapon for street-level violence but for the kind of targeted elimination that makes bodies look like accidents.
Properties.story_hooks: A sealed-habitat executive dies of apparent respiratory failure — the party is hired by his family, who suspect VACC-6 but can find no evidence because the compound has long since dissipated.; LAZARUS PHARMACEUTICALS approaches the party to recover stolen research files — the files contain the synthesis protocol for the VACC-6 compound, and someone is already selling copies.; The party's safehouse has been hit with a VACC-6 dispersal — they have 90 minutes to figure out who targeted them before the compound clears and evidence disappears.; A whistleblower from LAZARUS claims the compound has a secondary, undocumented effect: long-term trace accumulation in non-sealed environments that can be activated remotely by a specific radio frequency.

Nodes.Name: High-end fixers with access to tier-5 procurement channels
Rogue pharmaceutical researchers selling to private clients

Properties.description:
The Voltaic Resonance Disruptor operates by generating a tuned electromagnetic carrier wave that couples directly with the bioelectric field of living targets. Developed under ZHENG-DAO BIOELECTRIC's 'Project Harmonic' initiative, the VRD-3 emits a modulated burst that oscillates at frequencies specifically calibrated to interfere with sodium-potassium ion exchange across cell membranes. The result is a cascading depolarization event that spreads outward from the point of initial contact like a stone dropped in still water, disrupting voluntary motor function without causing immediate tissue death.

What distinguishes the VRD-3 from cruder electroshock platforms is its precision tuning system — a rotating dial on the receiver allows operators to shift the resonance band between incapacitation, sustained agony, and lethal cardiac interference. This tunability earned the weapon considerable interest from both law enforcement contractors and private security firms, though the lethal setting has since been restricted under Meridian 88's Bioelectric Harm Ordinance 7.4. Field technicians have long known that a simple hardware bypass restores full-spectrum functionality, and modification kits circulate freely in the lower districts.

The weapon's distinctive high-pitched harmonic whine during charge-up — colloquially called 'singing' — has made it impossible to deploy with any element of surprise. Experienced street operators have learned to exploit this: the sound alone is often enough to provoke compliance before a shot is ever fired. In the Shunt district, a drawn Livewire is understood as a social ultimatum.
Properties.specifications:
effective range: 18m (optimal), 30m (degraded)
charge time: 1.4 seconds
power source: ZHENG-DAO ZD-7 Galvanic Cell (12 shots per cell)
weight: 1.9 kg
length: 34 cm
settings: Incapacitation, Sustained Pain, Lethal (restricted)
resonance bands: 40 Hz – 220 Hz adjustable
housing: Matte polymer over conductive internal cage
Properties.tactical_use: Preferred in close-quarters detention and crowd suppression. Security operators typically use the incapacitation band to drop targets without lethal liability, then transition to physical restraint. Corporate extraction teams use modified units with the lethal band enabled for quiet termination operations where ballistic evidence must be avoided. The weapon's limited range makes it poorly suited for open engagements; operators typically close distance using cover before deploying.
Properties.cultural_context: The Livewire has become a class symbol in Meridian 88 — specifically, a symbol of institutional violence with plausible deniability. Corporate security personnel carry them openly as a statement of licensed authority. In the lower districts, possessing an unmodified VRD-3 signals someone with corporate ties or aspirations. A modified unit, by contrast, signals someone who has cut those ties and doesn't care who knows it. Street medics have developed protocols specifically for treating resonance cascade injuries, which they call 'singing sickness.'
Properties.story_hooks: A ZHENG-DAO whistleblower claims the VRD-3's lethal band was never actually restricted — only the documentation was changed. She has internal firmware logs to prove it.; A string of deaths in the Velour District show all the biological markers of cardiac resonance failure, but no VRD-3s are recovered at any scene. Someone is using an undetectable delivery method.; The modification kits flooding the market are suspiciously uniform — same machining tolerances, same component sourcing. Someone is manufacturing them at scale and distributing them deliberately.; A licensed security operator's VRD-3 spontaneously shifted to lethal band during a routine detention, killing the subject. The operator swears they never touched the dial. ZHENG-DAO is quietly buying the case files.

Nodes.Name: Modified-unit carriers in the Shunt district underworld
Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Acoustic Denial System ADS-9 'Silence'

Properties.description: A tripod-mounted acoustic weapon that projects a precisely calibrated anti-sound field, generating destructive interference patterns that cancel all sound within a targeted 20-meter zone. Within the zone, speech is impossible, radio communication is disrupted by the acoustic interference, gunshots produce no audible report, and alarms cannot be heard. The ADS-9 effectively creates a bubble of absolute silence — a disorienting, unnatural environment where the absence of sound is itself a weapon. Human targets within the zone report intense psychological distress, loss of spatial awareness, and difficulty maintaining balance without acoustic feedback.
Properties.aliases: Silence, ADS-9, Sound Wall, The Mute
Properties.specifications:
effect radius: 20-meter targeted zone
frequency cancellation: 20 Hz to 20 kHz — full human audible range
setup time: 45 seconds
power source: Vehicle feed or portable generator
weight: 28 kg on tripod
effect on electronics: Disrupts microphone-based systems within zone
psychological effect: Disorientation, balance disruption, anxiety
maximum deployment time: 30 minutes before emitter overheating
Properties.story_hooks: A bank robbery was executed inside an ADS-9 silence field — alarms did not sound, victims could not call for help, and security footage shows mouths opening in screams that produced no sound.; An ADS-9 has been permanently installed in a Tier 3 building's basement, creating a zone where no conversation can be recorded or overheard — it has become the most secure meeting space in Meridian 88.

Nodes.Name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Containment Foam Launcher CFL-2 'Amber'

Properties.description: A pressurized launcher that deploys a binary chemical foam which expands on contact with air and hardens within 8 seconds into a rigid, heat-resistant polymer shell. A single burst can encase a human-sized target in a cocoon of hardened foam strong enough to resist small arms fire and capable of immobilizing even augmented individuals. The foam is porous enough to allow breathing through small air channels that form during expansion, though the experience of being rapidly encased in hardening chemical foam is described by test subjects as one of the most claustrophobic experiences imaginable. Zheng-Dao markets it as a non-lethal capture system, and it has become standard equipment for corporate extraction teams.
Properties.aliases: Amber, CFL-2, Foam Gun, The Encaser
Properties.legality: Licensed — law enforcement and corporate security
Properties.specifications:
foam expansion: 40x volume in 3 seconds
hardening time: 8 seconds to full rigidity
compressive strength: 15 MPa when hardened
burst coverage: Sufficient to encase 1 human-sized target
tank capacity: 6 bursts per pressurized tank
effective range: 3-12 meters
weight: 9 kg loaded
dissolution: Proprietary solvent required, no natural degradation for 72+ hours
Properties.story_hooks: A target was found dead inside hardened Amber foam — the air channels failed to form properly in a defective batch, and the victim suffocated inside a rigid shell.; Someone has been encasing surveillance cameras across Tier 3 in containment foam, blinding entire security networks one node at a time — the foam is too hard to remove without damaging the equipment.

Nodes.Name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Graviton Lance GL-1 'Weight of the World'

Properties.description: An experimental directed gravitational manipulation weapon that projects a localized gravity well at a targeted point within 30 meters. The gravity well increases local gravitational force by a factor of 8-12x for approximately 3 seconds, causing everything within a 2-meter radius to be crushed downward with immense force. Personnel caught in the field are driven to the ground with enough force to shatter bone; vehicles buckle; structures collapse. The technology is derived from Zheng-Dao's industrial gravity press systems and represents the first known weaponization of gravitational manipulation. Only three prototypes are confirmed to exist.
Properties.aliases: Weight of the World, GL-1, Gravity Gun, The Anchor
Properties.legality: Experimental — not classified, no legal framework exists
Properties.specifications:
gravity multiplier: 8-12x local gravity
effect radius: 2 meters at target point
effect duration: 3 seconds
effective range: 5-30 meters
recharge: 45 seconds between activations
weight: 22 kg with power unit
power source: Dedicated micro-fusion cell, 8 activations per cell
prototypes confirmed: 3
Properties.story_hooks: A building collapse in Tier 3 shows structural damage patterns consistent with extreme localized gravitational stress — one of the three GL-1 prototypes may be in the field.; Zheng-Dao is offering an extraordinary bounty for information on the whereabouts of GL-1 prototype unit 2, which disappeared during a facility transfer — the bounty amount suggests they are terrified of what it could do in the wrong hands.

Nodes.Name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Mass Driver Turret MDT-6 'Trebuchet'

Properties.description: A vehicle-mounted electromagnetic mass driver that accelerates 5 kg projectiles to hypersonic velocity, functioning as a modern artillery piece with no chemical propellant. The MDT-6 uses a 20-stage linear electromagnetic accelerator mounted on a tracked vehicle chassis, capable of hurling dense metal projectiles up to 15 kilometers with GPS-guided precision. The impact of a 5 kg tungsten slug at Mach 7 produces a crater equivalent to a 500 kg bomb without any explosive — pure kinetic energy transfer. Zheng-Dao developed the MDT-6 for long-range fire support, and its ability to deliver devastating strikes with no explosive signature makes it difficult for counterbattery systems to detect and return fire on.
Properties.aliases: Trebuchet, MDT-6, Mass Driver, The Hurler
Properties.specifications:
projectile mass: 5 kg tungsten
muzzle velocity: Mach 7 (approximately 2,400 m/s)
maximum range: 15 kilometers
accelerator stages: 20-stage linear electromagnetic
rate of fire: 1 round per 20 seconds
magazine: 12 rounds in autoloader
mount: Tracked vehicle chassis
weight: 18,000 kg complete system
power source: Onboard fusion generator
Properties.story_hooks: An unexplained crater in Tier 3 has been attributed to a gas explosion, but the impact pattern is consistent with a mass driver strike — someone used strategic artillery inside the city.; A Zheng-Dao MDT-6 was disabled during transit and the vehicle crew was found dead with no visible wounds — the weapon was not stolen, but the fire control software was accessed.

Nodes.Name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Neutron Emitter NE-1 'Clean Sweep'

Properties.description: A directed neutron radiation weapon that kills biological organisms while leaving structures, equipment, and electronics completely intact. The NE-1 projects a focused beam of fast neutrons that pass through walls and cover, irradiating everything biological within the beam path with a lethal dose of radiation. Death from neutron exposure is not immediate — targets may survive for hours or days depending on dose, experiencing progressive organ failure as their cells die from radiation damage. The weapon's strategic value lies in its ability to kill the occupants of a building without damaging the building itself — perfect for seizing infrastructure, reclaiming facilities, or silently depopulating areas for reoccupation.
Properties.aliases: Clean Sweep, NE-1, Neutron Gun, The Cleaner
Properties.legality: Strategic weapon — Zheng-Dao sovereign authorization only
Properties.specifications:
beam type: Focused fast neutron emission
penetration: Passes through standard construction materials
lethal dose delivery: 10 seconds of exposure at 50 meters
effective range: 10-200 meters
weight: 85 kg on vehicle mount
power source: Onboard nuclear source + accelerator
crew: 3 operators with radiation shielding
death timeline: Hours to days depending on exposure duration
countermeasure: Borated polyethylene shielding, 10 cm minimum
Properties.story_hooks: An entire apartment building's residents died over 72 hours from what was officially called a chemical leak — but a radiation specialist has found neutron activation signatures in the building's steel structure.; A Zheng-Dao NE-1 was deployed against a fortified position during a corporate conflict, and the 'clean' building was reoccupied within hours — but the rapid reoccupation timeline suggests they knew it was a neutron weapon and had the seizure force ready before the attack.

Nodes.Name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Plasma Cutter PC-X1 'Dragon's Breath'

Properties.description: An experimental weapon that fires a bolt of superheated plasma contained within a magnetic bottle that maintains cohesion for approximately 40 meters before dissipating. The PC-X1 generates plasma by ionizing a hydrogen gas cartridge with an intense electrical arc, then magnetically accelerating the plasma bolt through a shaped barrel. On impact, the magnetic containment fails and the plasma expands explosively, producing a burst of thermal energy sufficient to melt through composite armor and ignite anything flammable within a 1-meter radius. The weapon is loud, visually spectacular, and tactically impractical at anything beyond close-medium range — but within that envelope, nothing survives a direct hit.
Properties.aliases: Dragon's Breath, PC-X1, Plasma Gun, The Torch
Properties.specifications:
plasma temperature: approximately 15,000°C at generation
effective range: 5-40 meters before containment dissipation
power source: Hydrogen gas cartridge + electrical arc generator
shots per cartridge: 4
recharge between shots: 8 seconds
weight: 7.5 kg
thermal bloom on impact: 1-meter radius
acoustic signature: 165 dB at muzzle — extremely loud
prototypes: 6 units in field testing
Properties.story_hooks: An armored convoy was destroyed by what witnesses describe as a bolt of fire that melted through the lead vehicle — the plasma impact signature on the wreckage is unmistakable.; One of the six PC-X1 prototypes has gone missing from Zheng-Dao's weapons lab and the security footage for that night has been erased — someone inside the company walked it out.

Nodes.Name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Rail Pistol RP-2 'Verdict'

Properties.description: A compact electromagnetic rail pistol that accelerates a 3mm tungsten slug to hypersonic velocity using a miniaturized two-stage rail system. The RP-2 represents Zheng-Dao's attempt to compress railgun technology into a sidearm format, and the compromises are significant — the weapon generates extreme heat per shot, has a four-round capacity, and the rail erosion means the barrel assembly must be replaced every 80 rounds. Despite these limitations, the sheer penetrating power of a hypersonic tungsten slug fired from a pistol-sized platform has made it sought after by operators who need to defeat heavy armor at close range.
Properties.specifications:
caliber: 3mm tungsten slug
muzzle velocity: 2,200 m/s
magazine: 4 rounds
barrel life: 80 rounds before rail replacement
weight: 1.8 kg
recharge time: 3 seconds between shots
power source: Integrated supercapacitor, 20 shots per charge
penetration: Rated for Grade 4 composite armor at 10 meters
Properties.story_hooks: A dead mercenary was found with an RP-2 that has been fired exactly 80 times — the barrel is spent but the weapon was never serviced, suggesting it was issued for a single extended operation.; Zheng-Dao is offering a bounty for the return of prototype RP-3 units that were stolen during transit — the prototypes supposedly solve the barrel erosion problem.

Nodes.Name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Resonance Hammer RH-3 'Earthquake'

Properties.description: A crew-served sonic weapon that generates a focused infrasonic pulse capable of inducing structural resonance in buildings, vehicles, and human bone. The RH-3 projects sound waves between 7-12 Hz at extreme amplitude through a parabolic emitter dish, creating a cone of effect where targets experience violent nausea, loss of equilibrium, and at close range, micro-fractures in the skeletal system. The weapon leaves no visible damage on structures but can fatigue load-bearing elements to the point of collapse over repeated application.
Properties.aliases: Earthquake, RH-3, Ground Pounder, Bass Drop
Properties.specifications:
frequency range: 7-12 Hz variable
amplitude: 185 dB at source
effective range: 10-80 meters cone
power source: Vehicle-mounted generator or heavy capacitor bank
weight: 62 kg (emitter assembly)
crew: 2 operators minimum
structural fatigue threshold: 4-6 sustained pulses on standard ferrocrete
Properties.story_hooks: Buildings in a Tier 2 neighborhood are spontaneously collapsing — structural engineers suspect infrasonic fatigue but no weapon deployments have been reported in the area.; A black market dealer is offering a miniaturized version of the RH-3 emitter that fits in a backpack — if it works, it changes the calculus of urban warfare entirely.

Nodes.Name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Siege Mortar SM-8 'Tremor'

Properties.description: A man-portable smart mortar system that fires programmable munitions to a maximum range of 800 meters with GPS-guided precision. The SM-8 weighs 12 kg fully loaded and can be set up and fired by a single operator in under 30 seconds. Each round carries a modular warhead that can be configured before loading — high explosive, smoke, illumination, or Zheng-Dao's signature seismic charge that buries itself 2 meters into the ground before detonating, creating a localized earthquake effect that collapses underground structures and disrupts foundations.
Properties.aliases: Tremor, SM-8, Mini Mortar, The Shaker
Properties.legality: Military restricted — active combat authorization only
Properties.specifications:
caliber: 60mm programmable munition
maximum range: 800 meters

warhead options: HE, smoke, illumination, seismic
