Vantablack Media Passive Emission Cartography System

Properties.description:
The Passive Emission Cartography System is a compact, non-transmitting surveillance device that builds a three-dimensional map of an environment by passively cataloguing all electromagnetic emissions present — radio frequencies, WiFi-equivalent mesh signals, cellular handshake traffic, Bluetooth-equivalent short-range protocols, and the low-frequency emissions of powered electronic equipment. Rather than actively scanning, the PECS simply listens, feeding a continuous stream of emission data into a spatial reconstruction algorithm that infers the physical layout of a space and the location of active devices within it. Over a dwell time of fifteen to thirty minutes, it produces a probabilistic floor plan accurate enough to identify rooms, corridors, and the approximate positions of networked devices and electronic equipment.

Vantablack's design philosophy is rooted in their media intelligence background — the system was originally developed to map the technical infrastructure of rival broadcast facilities and live event venues without physical access. The PECS produces no emissions of its own, making it essentially invisible to counter-surveillance sweeps that rely on detecting active scanning equipment. Its outputs are rendered as layered cartographic overlays, color-coded by emission type and confidence level, and can be exported to standard tactical display formats. The system cannot penetrate emission-shielded environments, but it excels at revealing the boundaries of shielded zones by mapping where emissions abruptly terminate.

In Meridian 88, the PECS has migrated from Vantablack's corporate intelligence operations into the hands of extraction teams, investigative journalists, and infrastructure saboteurs. Its passive nature makes it legally ambiguous — it receives only, and its operators argue it is no different in principle from a radio receiver. Authorities contest this framing vigorously, particularly when PECS-generated maps are found in conjunction with evidence of physical infiltration.
Properties.aliases: PECS, the Cartographer, signal map, ghost grid
Properties.tactical_use: Operators typically deploy the PECS in a concealed location — inside a bag, behind a structural element, or disguised as innocuous equipment — before a planned infiltration, allowing dwell time to accumulate while the team conducts other preparatory activity. The resulting map is reviewed to identify the locations of alarm systems, networked access points, security station equipment, and personnel devices. Experienced operators also use emission termination boundaries to map shielded rooms and vaults — the absence of signal is itself information. In counter-surveillance applications, a PECS sweep of a meeting location reveals any active electronic devices that should not be present.
Properties.cultural_context: The PECS occupies contested legal ground that Vantablack's legal division has defended aggressively, establishing a body of case precedent that treats passive reception as categorically distinct from active surveillance. This legal architecture is itself a Vantablack product — they sell the device and, implicitly, the legal cover that comes with it. Among professionals in the intelligence and extraction community, understanding the PECS's legal status in different jurisdictions is considered basic operational literacy. In the Mid-Ring's corporate security culture, PECS sweeps before sensitive meetings have become a standard counter-intelligence ritual, though many practitioners misunderstand the device's actual capabilities and limitations.
Properties.specifications: emission_bands_monitored: 900MHz–60GHz passive capture; low-frequency electronic emission detection (50Hz–10kHz); dwell_time_for_useful_output: 15–30 minutes for high-confidence mapping; spatial_accuracy: ±1.5m room-level accuracy at 30-minute dwell; ±0.5m with extended dwell; effective_range: Up to 80m radius in open structure; reduced by dense shielding; output_format: Layered cartographic overlay, exportable to standard tactical display formats; form_factor: Cylindrical passive array unit, 120mm diameter x 80mm height; deployable or handheld; weight: 520g; power_source: Internal cell, 8-hour continuous operation; data_storage: Encrypted local buffer, 72-hour rolling archive; counter-detection_profile: No active emissions; invisible to standard active-scan counter-surveillance
Properties.story_hooks: A PECS map recovered from an arrested infiltrator shows a floor plan of a facility that does not officially exist — the emissions profile matches no building in the city's architectural registry, but the coordinates place it beneath a block of condemned residential towers in the Sump District.; A team is hired to recover a PECS unit that was deployed and abandoned during a botched job. The device's buffer contains 60 hours of emission mapping for a high-security corporate campus — data that would be extraordinarily valuable and extraordinarily dangerous to possess.; A counter-surveillance sweep using a PECS reveals that a supposedly secure meeting location has an emission signature consistent with a concealed recording device operating on a frequency outside standard detection ranges — but the probabilistic confidence is only 65%, not enough to act on without more information.; Vantablack's legal division contacts a runner team with an unusual offer: defend a test case in which a PECS user is being prosecuted under a new surveillance statute. The outcome will set precedent that either legitimizes or effectively prohibits the device across the entire metro jurisdiction — and multiple powerful interests are watching.

Properties.description:
The Somatic Noise Cloak is a wearable signal disruption garment — a full-torso vest and sleeve assembly lined with Vantablack's proprietary Stochastic Emission Fabric, which generates a continuously randomized electromagnetic emission profile that mimics the ambient background noise of Meridian 88's densely saturated wireless environment. Rather than blocking or absorbing signals, the SNC actively broadcasts low-power noise across a broad spectrum, causing the wearer's electronic footprint to dissolve into the city's background chatter. Biometric sensors, passive RFID sweeps, and short-range identity interrogation systems read the wearer as environmental noise rather than a discrete target.

The garment's intelligence layer is a thin-film processor woven into the collar assembly that samples the local EM environment every 200 milliseconds and adjusts the emission profile to match. In high-traffic commercial zones, the SNC produces a denser, more complex noise signature; in quieter industrial or residential areas, it scales back to avoid the paradox of being the loudest silent thing in the room. Vantablack calls this the Ambient Calibration Loop, and it represents the company's most sophisticated application of their media-disruption research to a physical product. The vest is warm, slightly stiff, and has a faint electrical smell that users report fading after several wears.

The SNC was originally developed for Vantablack's own field journalists and embedded documentary crews operating in corporate-controlled zones where press credentials are selectively enforced. Its availability on the open market — at significant cost — reflects Vantablack's philosophy that information freedom is a consumer product. Corporate security contractors have lobbied unsuccessfully to have it classified as prohibited equipment; the current licensing requirement is enforced inconsistently at best.
Properties.aliases: Body Blur, Soma Cloak, VB Noise Wrap, SNC
Properties.tactical_use: Worn during transit through surveilled public spaces, corporate campuses, or controlled-access zones where passive identity scanning is routine. Most effective when combined with physical disguise and behavioral discipline — the SNC defeats electronic identification but does nothing for visual recognition. Used by journalists, runners, and anyone who needs to move through a monitored environment without leaving a trackable electronic record.
Properties.cultural_context: The Somatic Noise Cloak has become a minor status symbol in Meridian 88's civil liberties and anti-corporate activist communities, where wearing one is a political statement as much as a practical choice. Vantablack has leaned into this positioning, sponsoring events and embedding SNC imagery in their media content. Corporate security firms have responded by developing active scanning systems specifically designed to detect the Ambient Calibration Loop's characteristic emission signature — an arms race that Vantablack's engineers appear to relish. On the street, the garment's stiff profile and electrical smell make it recognizable to anyone who knows what to look for.
Properties.specifications: coverage: Full torso, shoulders, upper arms; emission_spectrum: 900MHz – 60GHz, continuously randomized; calibration_interval: 200ms; effective_against: Passive RFID sweep, biometric sensor arrays, short-range identity interrogation, standard wireless tracking; limitations: Does not defeat active millimeter-wave scanning or hardwired biometric systems; power_source: Integrated flat-cell battery, 18-hour operational life; garment_weight: 1.1kg; charging_method: Inductive pad, 2-hour full charge
Properties.story_hooks: A runner wearing an SNC discovers they are still being tracked — someone has developed a counter-detection system tuned specifically to the Ambient Calibration Loop's signature, and Vantablack hasn't issued a patch.; A dead activist is found with an SNC still active on her body — the garment's emission log contains a compressed record of every wireless environment she passed through in her final 18 hours.; Vantablack is quietly recalling a specific firmware version of the SNC after discovering the calibration processor was compromised during manufacturing — the affected units have been broadcasting a covert identifier to unknown receivers.; A corporate security director wants a runner to acquire an SNC from a Vantablack field journalist without alerting Vantablack — the journalist has been documenting something that hasn't been published yet.

Properties.description:
The Spectral Relay Shroud is a wearable signal architecture layered into a thin, flexible garment worn beneath street clothing — typically a vest or collar insert. It operates by fragmenting outgoing transmissions into thousands of microsecond-duration bursts, scattering them across seventeen discrete frequency bands simultaneously before reassembling them at the receiving end via a paired Vantablack decoder unit. The result is a signal profile that, to conventional intercept equipment, resembles nothing more coherent than ambient electromagnetic noise — radio ghost-chatter from old infrastructure, the static hiss of decaying city grid components.

What distinguishes the Shroud from competing signal-scatter systems is Vantablack's proprietary Chromatic Masking Layer, a passive analog component woven into the garment's lining that mimics the EM signature of the wearer's immediate environment. Near a power relay, the Shroud bleeds into the relay's hum. Near a corporate tower, it replicates the tower's passive emissions. This environmental mimicry is not digital — it cannot be patched out or remotely disabled — making the Shroud uniquely resilient against software-based spectrum sweeps.

The Shroud is a tool of journalists, fixers, and mid-tier syndicate coordinators who need persistent, low-detectability communication over extended operational periods rather than brief tactical bursts. Vantablack markets it obliquely through front distributors, framing it as 'signal privacy apparel' for executives concerned about corporate espionage — a fiction that provides useful legal cover while the product finds its true market in Meridian 88's lower precincts.
Properties.aliases: The Confessor, Ghost Tongue, Null Mouth
Properties.tactical_use: The Shroud is favored for long-duration operations where the operator must communicate repeatedly without establishing a detectable transmission pattern. Couriers use it to confirm drops without breaking stride. Field journalists use it to file dispatches from inside corporate exclusion zones. Because it requires no active device to hold or manipulate, it allows the user to appear entirely off-comms to visual surveillance while maintaining a live channel. Its primary limitation is latency — the reassembly process introduces a 1.2–2.8 second delay, making it unsuitable for real-time tactical coordination under fire.
Properties.cultural_context: In Meridian 88's information underclass — the fixers, the stringers, the mid-level syndicate workers who can't afford full ghost implants — the Shroud occupies a particular cultural niche as a symbol of professional seriousness. Wearing one signals that you've moved past burner handsets and disposable mesh nodes, that you operate at a level where persistent, deniable communication is a necessity rather than a luxury. Among investigative journalists in particular, owning a Shroud is a quiet credential, passed between colleagues like a reference. Vantablack's own employees are rumored to use them internally when communicating outside sanctioned channels — a detail the company neither confirms nor denies.
Properties.specifications: active_range: Up to 4.2 km direct; up to 18 km via mesh relay node; frequency_bands: 17 simultaneous, dynamically assigned; burst_duration: 0.003–0.09 seconds per fragment; power_source: Body-heat thermocouple array, 72-hour reserve cell backup; pairing_capacity: Up to 6 decoder units; weight: 340g (vest insert form factor); wash_cycles_rated: 200; EM_mimicry_update_rate: Every 8 seconds passive scan
Properties.story_hooks: A Shroud surfaces on a dead body — its paired decoder unit is still active and receiving, meaning someone is waiting for a transmission that will never come.; A player's Shroud begins mimicking a frequency profile that doesn't match any known local infrastructure — something is broadcasting nearby that shouldn't exist.; Vantablack quietly recalls a specific production batch of Shrouds, offering generous compensation and no questions. The batch numbers correspond to units distributed to a particular journalist collective six months before their silence.; A contact insists on meeting only via Shroud-channel, claiming that face-to-face or standard comms are already compromised — but the players have no way to verify whether the paranoia is justified or a setup.; The Chromatic Masking Layer on a black-market Shroud has been modified to mimic a specific corporate tower's EM signature — meaning any transmission through it will appear, to interceptors, to originate from inside that tower.

Nodes.Name: Fixer networks operating in signal-dense precincts

Properties.description:
The Vantablack Subvocal Relay Patch is a skin-adhered communications device roughly the size of a large bandage, worn over the throat or along the jaw. It intercepts the micro-vibrations produced by subvocal speech — the subtle muscular and laryngeal movements that occur when a person 'thinks' words without vocalizing them aloud — translates them into coherent audio through a proprietary neuromuscular signal processing algorithm, and transmits the result as an encrypted voice signal indistinguishable in quality from normal spoken communication. To an outside observer, the wearer appears completely silent, with no visible earpiece or microphone. The receiving end of the transmission is delivered through bone conduction via a secondary micro-patch worn behind the ear or along the jaw's ramus.

The Patch was developed by Vantablack Media's covert communications subsidiary — a division whose existence the corporation officially neither confirms nor denies — and represents a significant advancement over older subvocal technology, which required extensive individual calibration and produced low-fidelity output. The current generation of Patches uses a self-calibrating algorithm that maps each user's unique subvocal signature within approximately ninety seconds of first wear, achieving voice accuracy exceeding 97% without prior setup. The device is single-use by design: the biosignature calibration is locked to the first wearer's neuromuscular profile, and the adhesive substrate degrades after 72 hours of wear, after which the Patch must be discarded.

The Vantablack Subvocal Relay Patch is the communications tool of choice for operators who need to maintain team contact in environments where any visible communications hardware would be immediately suspicious — undercover infiltrations, social engineering operations, high-security social environments. It is also widely used by Meridian 88's security and protection details, where the ability to communicate without visible earpieces is a significant professional advantage. The single-use nature and premium pricing make it a marker of well-funded operations.
Properties.aliases: The Mutepiece, Throat Ghost, Skinwhisper, Black Patch
Properties.tactical_use: Applied before entry into a target environment. The wearer conducts the 90-second calibration during preparation or transit, ensuring the Patch is fully tuned before they go silent. In the field, communications are conducted entirely through subvocalization — mouthing words without sound, or in practiced operators, purely through the muscular intention to speak. The receiving bone conduction patch delivers incoming audio as vibration through the skull, inaudible to anyone else in the environment. Operators appear, to all external observation, to be simply standing or moving silently.
Properties.cultural_context: The Vantablack Subvocal Relay Patch occupies an interesting cultural position because it was originally marketed — through discreet corporate channels — as a premium professional communications tool for legitimate security personnel. This gives it a veneer of respectability that most covert comms equipment lacks, and licensed versions are used openly by executive protection teams, high-end event security, and corporate negotiation specialists. The same technology, acquired through gray-market channels without a license, is a staple of infiltration operators and undercover criminals. The identical appearance of licensed and unlicensed units makes them difficult for law enforcement to distinguish without documentation checks. Among operators, the Patch is sometimes called 'thinking out loud' — a quiet joke about speaking without speaking.
Properties.specifications: subvocal_accuracy: > 97% after 90-second self-calibration; calibration_time: 90 seconds (first wear); transmission_range: Up to 800 meters direct, 3 km with relay; encryption_standard: VBM-proprietary rolling cipher, 256-bit equivalent; transmission_profile: Indistinguishable from encrypted voice comms; bone_conduction_patch: Secondary micro-patch, 4 cm x 1.5 cm; operational_lifespan: 72 hours continuous wear; biosignature_lock: Single wearer, non-transferable after calibration; dimensions: Main patch: 7 cm x 4 cm x 0.2 cm; weight: 12 grams (main patch), 4 grams (bone conduction patch); power_source: Biogalvanic cell, powered by wearer's skin conductivity
Properties.story_hooks: A Vantablack Patch recovered from an operative at a crime scene has an anomalous biosignature lock — the calibration profile doesn't match any human neuromuscular signature on record, suggesting either a heavily modified user or that someone has found a way to fake the calibration process and transfer Patches between users.; The players are hired to work security at a high-profile event, equipped with licensed Vantablack Patches. Midway through the event, they begin receiving subvocal transmissions on their channel from an unknown source — someone else in the room is wearing an unlicensed Patch on the same encrypted channel, and they're feeding real-time intelligence to an unknown receiver.; Vantablack Media's covert communications subsidiary has quietly pushed a firmware update to all Patches in circulation — but the update contains an undisclosed feature that logs and transmits a compressed copy of all communications to a Vantablack server. Someone inside the company is trying to get this information out before the update rolls out to the entire installed base.; A deep-cover operative has been out of contact for three weeks. Their handler knows they were wearing a Vantablack Patch — which, if still on their body, is now well past its 72-hour lifespan. But someone has been sending transmissions on the operative's encrypted channel, in the operative's voice, for the past week.

Nodes.Name: Sable Voss — a social infiltration specialist known for penetrating corporate inner circles
Vantablack Media's own internal crisis communications team

Properties.description:
The Veil-9 is a full-body garment woven from a proprietary metamaterial lattice developed by Arcturus Defense Solutions. Microscopic hexagonal cells across the fabric's surface sample ambient light data via embedded photodiodes and re-emit it on the opposite side, creating a passable optical camouflage effect that blends the wearer into static or slowly-changing backgrounds. The system draws power from a flexible spine battery integrated into the back panel, offering roughly four hours of continuous active cloaking before requiring a recharge cycle.

What distinguishes the Veil-9 from cheaper imitators is its thermal management layer — a secondary membrane of aerogel composite interwoven with micro-channel coolant tubing that actively redistributes body heat across a wider surface area, reducing the wearer's IR signature to roughly that of ambient architecture. It does not eliminate thermal output entirely, but it smears it into an indistinct warm haze rather than a recognizable human silhouette. Military-grade thermal optics at close range can still identify a user, but standard corporate security sweeps and drone packages typically fail to flag the signature.

The Veil-9 is almost exclusively found in the hands of corporate black-ops units, high-end fixers, and the occasional well-funded freelancer who can stomach the price. On the street it carries a reputation slightly larger than its actual performance warrants — the name 'Veil' has become shorthand in certain circles for any serious cloaking rig, regardless of brand.
Properties.tactical_use: Primarily used for static infiltration and slow-movement operations — entering secured facilities, holding position in surveillance dead zones, or shadowing targets through low-traffic corridors. Users are trained to move deliberately; the shimmer distortion that appears at speed is the shroud's most notorious liability and has burned more than a few operators who panicked. Often paired with signal masking gear to prevent the suit's own EM emissions from betraying a position.
Properties.cultural_context: Owning a Veil-9 in Meridian 88 signals that you either work for someone with serious resources or you've done something very specific and very dangerous to acquire one. The suits don't appear on any civilian market — every unit is theoretically serialized and tracked by Arcturus, though black-market units with scrubbed IDs circulate at extreme markup. Among street-level operators, wearing 'a Veil' is aspirational shorthand; actually wearing a real one marks you as someone who has moved past the amateur tier entirely.
Properties.specifications: optical_camouflage_rating: 87% diffusion at >3m range, 61% at <1m; thermal_suppression: Reduces IR signature to ~0.4x baseline human output; active_duration: 4.2 hours continuous at full output; recharge_time: 45 minutes via standard port; weight: 1.8 kg; failure_mode: Visible shimmer distortion under rapid movement above 12 km/h; power_source: Integrated flexible spine battery, 3,400 mAh equivalent; form_factor: Full-body suit, hood included, gloves sold separately
Properties.story_hooks: A Veil-9 with an intact serial number surfaces on the black market — the number traces to a unit officially destroyed in a classified op three years ago. Someone is selling something they shouldn't have.; A player's contact goes silent mid-job; the only evidence they were ever there is a faint thermal smear on a security recording that the client swears is a ghost.; Arcturus quietly offers a bounty for the return of 'misappropriated assets' — no questions asked, significant payout. The assets in question are six Veil-9 suits, and whoever took them hasn't used them yet.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Acoustic Mapping Drone AMD-2

Properties.description: A small drone equipped with an array of ultrasonic emitters and receivers that maps enclosed spaces using echolocation, creating detailed 3D maps of rooms, corridors, and structures without line-of-sight. The AMD-2 can be launched into a building through a ventilation grate or window and will autonomously navigate the interior using its acoustic mapping to build a complete floorplan, identifying occupants by their acoustic signatures, locating electronic devices by their operational sounds, and mapping structural elements including hidden rooms and passages that may not be visible.
Properties.aliases: AMD-2, Sound Mapper, Echo Drone, Bat Bot
Properties.specifications: mapping method: Ultrasonic echolocation; resolution: 2 cm structural detail; occupant detection: Acoustic signature — heartbeat; info: breathing; movement; device detection: Operational sound identification; flight time: 30 minutes; map generation: Real-time 3D construction; size: 15 cm rotor-to-rotor; weight: 0.25 kg; acoustic range: 30-meter radius mapping
Properties.story_hooks: An AMD-2 acoustic map of a building revealed a hidden room that does not appear on any plans — the room is occupied, and the acoustic signatures suggest multiple people have been inside for days.; An AMD-2 was launched into an abandoned structure and its acoustic map revealed that the building is not abandoned — dozens of heartbeat signatures were detected across multiple floors.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Atmospheric Sampling Drone ASD-5

Properties.description: A weather-resistant drone equipped with a comprehensive atmospheric analysis suite for environmental monitoring, contamination assessment, and air quality mapping. The ASD-5 samples air at altitude and analyzes particulates, chemical compounds, biological agents, and radiation levels in real-time, creating 3D atmospheric maps that show contamination plumes, clean air corridors, and threat concentrations. The drone can operate in adverse weather conditions including rain, high winds, and extreme temperatures, making it suitable for emergency response and contamination zone assessment.
Properties.aliases: ASD-5, Air Tester, Sky Sampler, Atmosphere Scout
Properties.specifications: analysis: Particulates; info: chemicals; biological agents; radiation; 60 km/h winds; -20°C to +50°C; mapping: Real-time 3D atmospheric composition; altitude: Up to 500 meters; flight time: 2 hours; weather resistance: Rain; sampling rate: Continuous analysis during flight; data transmission: Real-time encrypted to ground station; weight: 2.5 kg; size: 40 cm rotor-to-rotor
Properties.story_hooks: An ASD-5 mapping a Tier 2 district detected an unknown biological agent at altitude that ground-level sensors had not registered — something is being dispersed from above, and the source is not visible.; ASD-5 atmospheric data has revealed that air quality in a specific district varies on a schedule that correlates with shift changes at a factory 5 km away — the factory is venting contaminants during off-hours when monitoring is reduced.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Autonomous Package Delivery Drone APDD-6

Properties.description: A cargo drone capable of autonomously delivering packages up to 5 kg across Meridian 88 using Vespid's Autonomous Navigation Mesh. The APDD-6 navigates urban airspace, avoids obstacles and other aircraft, and delivers payloads to designated GPS coordinates or directly to a recipient identified by neural interface beacon. The drone is weather-resistant, tamper-detecting, and equipped with a cargo bay that can be configured for standard packages, medical supplies, or temperature-controlled pharmaceutical transport.
Properties.aliases: APDD-6, Mail Bug, Package Drone, Delivery Wasp
Properties.specifications: payload: 5 kg maximum; range: 30 km on single charge; speed: 60 km/h cruise; navigation: Vespid ANM + GPS; recipient identification: GPS coordinates or neural interface beacon; cargo bay: 30x20x15 cm; info: configurable; tamper detection: Alerts on unauthorized opening; weight: 3 kg empty; weather: Rain and 40 km/h wind capable
Properties.story_hooks: APDD-6 drones have been hijacked in flight and their cargo redirected to unknown recipients — the hijacking exploits a vulnerability in the neural interface beacon system.; An APDD-6 was loaded with an explosive device instead of a package — it delivered itself to the target's door, and the tamper detection that should have flagged the payload was disabled.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Compound Eye Surveillance Cluster

Properties.description: A deployable surveillance device consisting of 12 micro-cameras mounted on flexible stalks extending from a central hub, providing 360-degree visual coverage from a single mounting point. Each camera stalk can be independently positioned and focused, and the combined feed creates a composite image with no blind spots. The device adheres to surfaces with a gecko-pad base and draws power from an integrated solar cell, operating indefinitely in lit environments. The Compound Eye's individual cameras are each smaller than a shirt button, making the deployed device easy to overlook despite its multi-stalk profile.
Properties.aliases: Compound Eye, Bug Eye, Vespid Watch, Multi-Cam
Properties.specifications: camera count: 12 independent stalks; coverage: 360-degree spherical; resolution: 4K per camera; info: composited; 500m range; independently posable; power source: Integrated solar cell + 72-hour battery backup; mounting: Gecko-pad adhesive base; transmission: Encrypted burst transmission; weight: 0.04 kg; stalk length: 3 cm each
Properties.story_hooks: A sweep of a Tier 3 apartment building discovered 40+ Compound Eye devices installed in hallways, stairwells, and common areas — someone has been running total surveillance on the building's residents for months.; A Compound Eye device was found inside a corporate boardroom that had been transmitting to a receiver outside the building — the device had been in place for six weeks without detection.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Counter-Drone Electronic Warfare Kit CDEW-2

Properties.description: A portable electronic warfare kit designed to detect, track, and disable hostile drones through signal jamming, GPS spoofing, and direct electromagnetic pulse. The CDEW-2 includes a drone detection radar, a directional jammer that can sever the control link between a drone and its operator, a GPS spoofer that feeds false position data to cause the drone to fly to a designated capture zone, and a focused EMP emitter that can permanently disable drone electronics at up to 50 meters. Vespid sells the kit as defense against their competitors' drone platforms — and their own, for clients who want protection from all aerial threats.
Properties.aliases: CDEW-2, Drone Killer, Bug Zapper, Swat Kit
Properties.specifications: detection radar: 2 km drone detection range; jammer: Directional; info: severs control link at 500m; permanent disable; GPS spoofer: Redirects drone to capture zone; EMP emitter: 50-meter focused pulse; weight: 5 kg complete kit; battery: 4 hours active; form factor: Backpack-mounted; target: Single to swarm-scale drone threats
Properties.story_hooks: A CDEW-2 was used to capture a Vespid surveillance drone intact — the drone's data cache contained months of surveillance footage that Vespid claims was collected under legitimate authorization.; A modified CDEW-2 has been developed that does not disable hostile drones but instead takes control of them — the captured drones join the defender's network and can be turned against their original operator.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Micro-Drone Swarm Carrier MDC-1

Properties.description: A hip-mounted carrier that houses, charges, and deploys up to 30 micro-drones for on-demand aerial reconnaissance, communications relay, and area surveillance. The MDC-1 serves as a mobile base station for Vespid's insect-scale drone platforms, providing charging cradles, data uplink, and deployment tubes that can launch drones individually or in coordinated bursts. The carrier's AI manages swarm deployment patterns, return-to-base protocols, and battery cycling to maintain continuous aerial coverage. A single operator with an MDC-1 can establish a persistent surveillance network over a 500-meter radius.
Properties.aliases: MDC-1, Hive Carrier, Bug Box, Swarm Pack
Properties.specifications: drone capacity: 30 micro-drones; charging: 10 cradles; info: 15 minutes per full charge; deployment: Individual or burst (up to 10 simultaneous); control: Integrated AI swarm management; coverage radius: 500 meters persistent surveillance; data: Real-time video/audio feed from all active drones; weight: 2.8 kg loaded; form factor: Hip-mounted carrier; battery: 8-hour swarm management
Properties.story_hooks: An MDC-1 carrier was stolen along with its full drone complement — 30 micro-drones are now operating in an uncontrolled urban environment, following their last programmed orders indefinitely.; A rival manufacturer has developed a micro-drone jammer disguised as an MDC-1 carrier — it appears to deploy drones but actually emits a signal that disables all micro-drones within range.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Perimeter Alert Micro-Drone Network PAMN-2

Properties.description: A set of 20 micro-drones that establish an automated perimeter surveillance network, orbiting a designated area and alerting the operator to any intrusion. The PAMN-2 drones are the size of large moths and operate silently at night, using thermal and motion sensors to detect human-sized movement within the perimeter. When an intrusion is detected, the nearest drone illuminates the target with IR for identification while transmitting an alert to the operator's neural interface. The network automatically repositions to maintain coverage if individual drones are lost.
Properties.aliases: PAMN-2, Watch Bugs, Perimeter Swarm, Alert Net
Properties.specifications: drone count: 20; perimeter radius: Up to 200 meters; sensors: Thermal + motion per drone; alert: Neural interface notification with IR illumination; flight time: 6 hours per drone; info: staggered rotation; self-healing: Automatic repositioning on drone loss; noise: Sub-20 dB — effectively silent; weight: 1.5 kg for complete set with charger
Properties.story_hooks: A PAMN-2 network detected an intrusion that the drones could not identify — the thermal signature was there but the shape was not human, and the movement pattern did not match any known animal.; Someone deployed PAMN-2 drones around a rival's home to monitor their daily patterns — the surveillance was detected when a neighbor noticed moths flying in perfect geometric circles at midnight.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Pheromone Trail Marker PTM-2

Properties.description: A wrist-mounted dispenser that releases invisible synthetic pheromone compounds to mark a path, location, or target. The PTM-2 uses Vespid's pheromone library to create markers detectable only by specialized sensors or Vespid drone platforms, creating invisible trails that can be followed hours or days after being laid. Different pheromone compounds encode different meanings — danger, safe passage, target location, rally point — allowing the creation of an invisible information layer overlaid on the physical environment. The markers persist on surfaces for 48-72 hours depending on weather conditions.
Properties.aliases: PTM-2, Scent Trail, Path Marker, Invisible Breadcrumbs
Properties.specifications: compounds: 8 distinct pheromone markers; persistence: 48-72 hours on surfaces; detection: Vespid drone platforms or specialized sensor; application: Spray from wrist-mounted dispenser; range: Contact application — spray on surface from 30 cm; capacity: 200 applications per cartridge; weight: 0.08 kg; visibility: Invisible to human senses; detection range: Drone platforms detect at 50 meters
Properties.story_hooks: A pheromone trail was discovered leading from a secure facility's emergency exit to a waiting vehicle location — someone marked the escape route in advance using PTM-2 compounds.; Vespid's drones have been following PTM-2 trails that were not laid by authorized operators — someone has obtained the pheromone compounds and is manipulating Vespid's own drone networks.

Properties.description: A ground-based surveillance micro-drone the size and shape of a large beetle that navigates terrain autonomously, recording audio and video while being virtually indistinguishable from a real insect at casual observation. The RB-2 moves on six articulated legs that mimic insect locomotion, can climb walls, squeeze through gaps as small as 2 cm, and operates for 48 hours on a single charge. Its shell is colored and textured to match local insect populations, and it generates realistic insect movement patterns when stationary to avoid detection. The drone transmits compressed data bursts on a schedule to minimize RF signature.
Properties.aliases: Recon Beetle, RB-2, Bug Scout, Crawler
Properties.specifications: size: 4 cm length; info: insect profile; wall climbing capable; 200m range; locomotion: 6 articulated legs; gap clearance: 2 cm minimum opening; battery life: 48 hours active; transmission: Scheduled compressed burst; sensors: HD camera + directional microphone; speed: 5 cm/sec maximum; autonomous navigation: Terrain mapping + obstacle avoidance
Properties.story_hooks: A sweep of a sensitive facility found 14 RB-2 drones operating simultaneously in different rooms — someone has been running comprehensive ground-level surveillance for weeks.; An RB-2 was crushed by a target who noticed unusual insect behavior — the drone's data cache was intact and contained audio of conversations that implicate multiple corporate officers.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Swarm Relay Beacon SRB-4

Properties.description: A portable beacon that serves as a command-and-control relay point for Vespid drone swarms, extending operational range and providing a rally point for autonomous drone assets. The SRB-4 broadcasts encrypted control signals, collects sensor data from drones within range, and can serve as an autonomous command node if communication with the primary controller is lost. Multiple beacons can be networked to create a mesh of relay points covering an entire operational area. The beacon also serves as a charging station for micro-drones, with inductive pads that recharge up to four drones simultaneously.
Properties.aliases: SRB-4, Drone Beacon, Swarm Point, Rally Flag
Properties.specifications: relay range: 1 kilometer radius; control capacity: Up to 50 drones per beacon; charging pads: 4 inductive micro-drone chargers; mesh networking: Up to 10 beacons per network; autonomous mode: Maintains last orders if controller lost; battery: 48-hour operation; weight: 0.8 kg; form factor: Cylinder; info: 15 cm tall; magnetic base; deployment: Hand-placed or drone-delivered
Properties.story_hooks: SRB-4 beacons have been found placed throughout a Tier 2 district in a grid pattern — someone is building a drone operations infrastructure across the entire district without authorization.; An SRB-4 in autonomous mode has been maintaining a drone patrol pattern around a building for three weeks after its controller was killed — the drones are protecting something their dead operator cared about.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Thermal Decoy Beacon TDB-3

Properties.description: A small device that generates a thermal signature mimicking a human body, drawing the attention of thermal imaging systems and heat-seeking autonomous weapons away from real targets. The TDB-3 produces a 37°C heat pattern in a human-shaped profile using embedded heating elements, and can be placed on walls, floors, or furniture to create false targets. The beacon operates for 12 hours on a single charge and can be configured to simulate stationary, walking, or running thermal profiles.
Properties.aliases: TDB-3, Heat Fake, Warm Ghost, Thermal Lure
Properties.specifications: thermal signature: 37°C human-profile pattern; profiles: Stationary; info: walking; running simulation; battery: 12 hours continuous; weight: 0.15 kg; size: 15 cm disc; placement: Adhesive mounting on any surface; quantity typically deployed: 4-8 per operation; effectiveness: Defeats standard thermal imaging and heat-seeking systems
Properties.story_hooks: A building assault team placed 20 TDB-3 beacons around the target structure — the defending thermal sensors showed 20 approaching hostiles when the actual team was 5 people entering from the one unmonitored approach.; TDB-3 beacons have been placed throughout a Tier 2 district to overwhelm corporate thermal surveillance with false human signatures — the system is drowning in phantom contacts and real threats are invisible.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Toxic Environment Navigation Drone TEND-3

Properties.description: A ruggedized drone designed to navigate chemically, biologically, or radiologically contaminated environments and map safe passage routes for human operators. The TEND-3 carries a comprehensive CBRN sensor suite and projects its findings as a real-time 3D contamination map, highlighting lethal zones, marginal areas, and safe corridors. The drone can operate in environments that would kill an unprotected human — toxic gas concentrations, high radiation fields, and biological contamination zones — and its sealed construction prevents it from becoming a contamination vector on return. It has become essential equipment for operations in Meridian 88's legacy contamination zones.
Properties.aliases: TEND-3, Hazard Scout, Poison Mapper, Safe Path
Properties.specifications: sensors: Chemical; info: biological; radiation; particulate; mapping: Real-time 3D contamination model; environmental tolerance: Chemical/biological/radiation environments; sealed construction: Prevents cross-contamination; flight time: 45 minutes; operating range: 500 meters from controller; weight: 1.5 kg; decontamination: UV + chemical wash protocol between missions
Properties.story_hooks: A TEND-3 mapping a legacy contamination zone discovered a pocket of breathable air deep inside a toxic area — inside the pocket was a functioning habitat where someone has been living in the middle of a wasteland.; A TEND-3 sent into a suspected chemical attack site returned data showing a contaminant that does not match any known industrial or military compound — it is something new, and it is spreading.

Nodes.Name: Vespid Dynamics Wasp Eye Tactical Monocle WE-3

Properties.description: A multi-spectral optical device worn as a monocle or clip-on lens that overlays tactical information onto the wearer's visual field. The WE-3 combines visible light enhancement, thermal imaging, electromagnetic field visualization, and AR data overlays into a single eyepiece that can be switched between modes or display composite views. The device interfaces with neural implants for heads-up display integration and can share its feed with linked devices. Vespid designed it as a lightweight alternative to full tactical helmets for operators who need sensor capability without the bulk and visibility of military headgear.
Properties.aliases: Wasp Eye, WE-3, Tac Monocle, Smart Eye
Properties.specifications: modes: Visual enhancement; info: thermal; EM field; AR overlay; composite; resolution: 8K per mode; neural interface: Direct HUD integration; feed sharing: Encrypted to linked devices; weight: 0.03 kg; form factor: Monocle or clip-on lens; battery: 24-hour; zoom: 1-8x digital with stabilization; EM field detection: 1 MHz to 300 GHz visualization
Properties.story_hooks: A WE-3 in EM visualization mode detected an unknown signal emanating from inside a person's skull — the signal was not from any known neural interface model and its purpose is unidentifiable.; Modified WE-3 units with facial recognition and criminal database access have become standard equipment for vigilante groups in Tier 2 — they are scanning every face they see and acting on the results.

Properties.description:
The Chemoreceptive Dermal Patch is a biosynthetic sensor array worn against the skin — typically on the inner wrist or neck — that detects and identifies airborne chemical compounds by mimicking the molecular binding mechanisms of biological olfactory receptors. Unlike electronic chemical sensors that rely on catalytic reactions or spectroscopic sampling, the CDP uses a matrix of engineered protein receptors derived from Zheng-Dao's proprietary synthetic biology platform, allowing it to detect trace concentrations of target compounds at parts-per-billion sensitivity. The patch communicates detections through a haptic feedback layer that produces distinct vibrational patterns for different compound classes, supplemented by a companion device that provides full chemical identification.

Zheng-Dao's biological approach gives the CDP a sensitivity profile closer to a trained detection animal than to conventional electronic sensors, but without the false-positive rates that plague organic systems. The receptor matrix is tuned at manufacture for one of several mission profiles: a narcotics-detection variant, an explosives and propellant variant, a toxic industrial chemical variant, and a classified variant marketed exclusively to Arcturus Defense Solutions and certain government clients. The patch has a functional lifespan of approximately 72 hours before the protein receptors degrade, after which it must be replaced. Spent patches are biologically inert and disposable.

The CDP was originally developed for customs and contraband interdiction, and it remains standard issue for Meridian 88's port authority inspectors. Its civilian adoption has been slower, partly due to cost and partly due to a persistent cultural unease about wearing a bioengineered organism on one's skin. Among close-protection operatives and private security, however, it has become valued for its ability to detect the chemical signatures of recently fired weapons, certain stimulants used to suppress fear responses in hostile actors, and the off-gassing of specific explosive compounds used in improvised devices.
Properties.aliases: Skin-sniffer, CDP, the Patch, chemical tongue
Properties.tactical_use: Operatives typically wear the EP variant during escort and close-protection assignments, relying on the haptic feedback to provide passive continuous monitoring without requiring active attention. The patch is most effective in enclosed spaces where compound concentrations build — elevators, vehicle interiors, and confined corridors. Experienced users learn to interpret the vibration intensity as a rough proxy for concentration, allowing them to gauge proximity to a source. In counter-narcotics operations, the ND variant is used during interviews and searches to detect the residue compounds that linger on skin and clothing long after handling.
Properties.cultural_context: In Meridian 88's port districts and customs zones, the CDP is as mundane as a scanning wand — inspectors wear them as routine kit. Elsewhere, visible CDP use signals a level of threat anticipation that can itself be a social statement. Close-protection operatives who wear them during civilian escort jobs are sometimes seen as paranoid or provocative by clients unaccustomed to that level of security theater. In underground circles, knowing the CDP's detection profile has become operational knowledge — certain chemical masking agents are sold specifically to defeat the narcotics variant's receptor matrix, with varying degrees of actual effectiveness.
Properties.specifications: detection_sensitivity: Parts-per-billion for primary target compounds; compound_library: Variant-dependent; standard variants cover 200-400 indexed compounds; feedback_mechanism: Haptic vibration patterns (compound-class level) + companion reader for full identification; patch_lifespan: 72 hours active; 120 hours in low-exposure storage; variants: Narcotics Detection (ND), Explosives and Propellant (EP), Toxic Industrial Chemical (TIC), Classified (C-variant, restricted distribution); form_factor: Flexible adhesive patch, 40mm x 25mm; weight: Negligible (8g including adhesive backing); operating_temperature: 5°C to 45°C; companion_device: Zheng-Dao CDP Reader (palm-sized, Bluetooth-equivalent encrypted link)
Properties.story_hooks: A close-protection operative's CDP patch triggers a propellant signature during a routine escort — but the client insists no one in the party has handled a weapon in weeks, and the source cannot be located before the convoy reaches its destination.; A black market chemist claims to have synthesized a compound that defeats all four CDP variants simultaneously. The formula is being auctioned to the highest bidder, and multiple parties — including Zheng-Dao's own security division — want it suppressed or acquired.; A runner discovers that their CDP patch has been triggering on a specific person in their network for three separate meetings. The compound signature matches nothing in the standard library, suggesting either a novel synthetic substance or a compound from the classified C-variant's restricted index.; Port authority records show that a CDP-equipped inspector filed a detection report three days before going missing. The report was flagged, suppressed, and the inspector's unit reassigned — someone with administrative access does not want that chemical signature investigated.

Properties.description:
The Ciliary Mesh Frond is a bio-synthetic mesh network node grown from Zheng-Dao's proprietary piezoelectric cilia substrate — a branching, fern-like structure roughly the size of a hand that adheres to most surfaces and begins passively harvesting micro-vibrations within minutes of deployment. These harvested vibrations are converted into carrier energy that powers a low-footprint, frequency-hopping mesh relay, capable of extending an encrypted network node into areas with no existing infrastructure. The Frond is literally alive in a limited sense: its cilia respond to environmental stimuli, adjusting their resonance frequency to optimize signal routing without active user input.

The device's distinctive property is its near-zero RF emission profile during idle states. Rather than broadcasting continuously, the Frond listens and responds — it activates only when a paired handshake signal passes within range, acting as a silent repeater that leaves almost no trace on passive spectrum scans. Its biological substrate also means it registers as organic matter on most bio-scanners, not electronics, which allows it to pass through checkpoints concealed in plant material, food packaging, or even worn against skin under loose clothing.

Zheng-Dao markets the Frond to corporate field teams for infrastructure-denied environments, but its properties have made it equally popular among resistance cells and insurgent networks in Meridian 88's outer districts. The irony that a Zheng-Dao product underpins much of the anti-corporate mesh in the city's peripheral zones is not lost on anyone — least of all Zheng-Dao's internal security division, which has reportedly been trying to introduce a remote-kill pathway into newer production runs.
Properties.aliases: the Fern, Cilia Net, Whisker Relay
Properties.tactical_use: Deployed in advance of an operation to extend mesh network coverage into infrastructure-denied zones — abandoned sectors, corporate-locked districts, or areas under signal suppression. A single operative can seed a relay chain by placing Fronds along a route, creating an ephemeral private network that dissolves when the substrate is retrieved or degrades. Useful for coordinating multi-team operations without touching public or corporate communication infrastructure.
Properties.cultural_context: The Frond has acquired a quiet symbolic weight in Meridian 88's outer districts, where residents have built permanent informal mesh networks from illegally obtained units. Finding a Frond adhered to a wall or ceiling in a squat or underground meeting space signals that the space is connected — part of the city's shadow infrastructure. Some community organizers have begun cultivating them openly as a statement, daring corporate security to arrest someone for growing a plant.
Properties.specifications: relay_range: Up to 200m per node in open conditions; reduced in dense construction; network_capacity: Supports up to 12 simultaneous paired devices; power_source: Self-sustaining via ambient vibration harvesting; supplemental micro-cell extends range by 40%; activation_latency: 80–120ms from handshake signal to relay-active state; lifespan: Approximately 18 months before substrate degradation; form_factor: Branching frond structure, ~22cm at full extension; collapsible to 8cm for transport; scanner_profile: Registers as organic matter on standard bio-scans; requires specialized EM analysis to identify
Properties.story_hooks: A player discovers a Frond network in a supposedly abandoned sector — it's active, maintained, and routing traffic for someone who shouldn't be there.; Zheng-Dao reaches out through back channels: they want the players to recover a specific Frond from a resistance cache before a security audit team finds it and traces the network back to a Zheng-Dao employee who's been helping the resistance.; A new production run of Fronds has hit the black market, but three separate mesh networks built on them have gone silent simultaneously — something in the update is wrong.; A Frond has been growing on the exterior wall of a corporate checkpoint for eight months without anyone noticing; it's been logging every encrypted handshake that passes through.
