The systems interpret any approach as a threat, and their adaptive learning means that attempts to penetrate the perimeter only make future attempts harder. Several APDE installations have been effectively abandoned by their operators but continue defending their perimeter against all comers, including the maintenance crews sent to deactivate them.
Properties.story_hooks: An APDE installation has evolved its biological barrier component into something unexpected — the engineered vegetation has begun growing beyond its designated perimeter, spreading irritant-laden thorned plants into a residential district.; A decommissioned APDE system has been reactivated by an unknown party and is now defending an area that contains something nobody knew was there — whatever is inside the perimeter, someone wanted it protected enough to restart a military defense system.

Nodes.Name: Carrion Defense Works Autonomous Wound Treatment System

Properties.description: An implantable medical system that automatically detects and treats injuries without conscious intervention. The AWTS consists of a network of subdural sensors that monitor tissue integrity, blood pressure, and chemical markers for injury, connected to micro-reservoirs of hemostatic agents, analgesics, and antibiotics that deploy automatically at wound sites. When the system detects a penetrating wound, it immediately seals the wound channel with hemostatic foam, administers localized pain suppression, and begins antibiotic prophylaxis — all within 2 seconds of injury, before the patient has finished flinching.
Properties.aliases: AWTS, Auto Medic, Carrion Patch, Battle Surgeon
Properties.social_impact: AWTS has changed the survival calculus of violence — augmented individuals with the system survive injuries that would kill anyone else, creating a durability gap between equipped and unequipped populations. The system has also enabled a reckless combat culture among those who have it, since the immediate consequences of being shot or stabbed are dramatically reduced. Long-term, the system's reservoir depletion is a significant concern — operators who sustain multiple injuries may exhaust their medical supplies without realizing it.
Properties.story_hooks: An AWTS-equipped operative sustained twelve gunshot wounds during an engagement and remained operational throughout — they only collapsed when the hemostatic reservoirs ran dry on wound thirteen.; Someone has developed a weapon specifically designed to overwhelm AWTS by creating dozens of superficial wounds simultaneously, depleting the system's reservoirs before delivering the killing blow.

Nodes.Name: Carrion Defense Works Bioweapon Detection Lattice

Properties.description: A network of air-sampling sensors deployed across ventilation systems, transit hubs, and public spaces that continuously analyzes atmospheric composition for biological threat agents. The BDL uses mass spectrometry and gene-sequencing micro-chips to identify known pathogens, engineered biological agents, and novel organisms within 90 seconds of detection. The irony of Carrion Defense Works — a company that manufactures biological delivery systems — also manufacturing the detection infrastructure for those same systems is not lost on anyone. Carrion maintains that the defense and offense divisions operate independently.
Properties.aliases: BDL, Plague Fence, Carrion Sniffer, Bio Net
Properties.social_impact: The BDL has become standard infrastructure in mid-to-upper tier districts, creating a baseline expectation of biological security that lower tiers lack. The system's data flows through Carrion's analysis servers, giving the company comprehensive knowledge of every biological anomaly in equipped zones — information that is commercially and strategically valuable. Privacy advocates note that the BDL's atmospheric sampling can detect pharmaceutical metabolites, recreational drug use, and health conditions in population-aggregate data.
Properties.story_hooks: The BDL in a Tier 3 district detected a novel pathogen that does not match any known biological agent — the alert was suppressed by someone with access to Carrion's network before public health authorities were notified.; Carrion's offense division is using BDL detection data to calibrate their biological delivery systems — they are literally using their own defense product's data to make their weapons harder to detect.

Nodes.Name: Early warning for engineered pathogen deployment
Rapid identification of novel biological agents
Carrion Defense Works Psychological Operations Broadcasting System

Properties.description: An integrated psychological warfare platform that combines directional audio, subliminal visual projection, atmospheric scent dispersal, and neural interface frequency modulation to induce specific emotional states in target populations. The POBS can generate fear, confusion, compliance, or aggression in individuals and crowds by simultaneously attacking multiple sensory and cognitive channels. The system's directional capabilities allow it to affect specific areas while leaving adjacent zones unaffected, creating sharp boundaries between calm and chaos that are themselves psychologically destabilizing.
Properties.aliases: POBS, Fear Machine, Carrion Voice, Dread Broadcast
Properties.social_impact: POBS deployment represents the militarization of psychology — the ability to make people feel anything, regardless of their actual circumstances, by attacking their sensory and cognitive processing simultaneously. The system has been used for crowd control, perimeter defense, and interrogation support, but its deeper implication is that human emotions can be manufactured and deployed as weapons. In a POBS-equipped environment, your fear might not be your own — it might be someone else's tactical decision.
Properties.story_hooks: A POBS installation has malfunctioned and is broadcasting a sustained fear response across a residential district — thousands of people are experiencing irrational terror and the system cannot be remotely deactivated.; Someone has reverse-engineered POBS technology and installed a DIY version in a nightclub that broadcasts euphoria — the club is the most popular venue in Meridian 88, and the patrons do not know why they feel so good.

Nodes.Name: Carrion Defense Works Tactical Deception Network

Properties.description: An integrated electronic warfare system that creates false sensor signatures, spoofed communications, and simulated force dispositions to deceive enemy intelligence systems. The TDN deploys a network of emitters that generate the electromagnetic, thermal, acoustic, and visual signatures of military assets that do not exist — fake vehicles, phantom troop formations, simulated communications traffic, and holographic equipment. The system can make an empty field look like a military base to every sensor modality simultaneously, creating a comprehensive deception that is indistinguishable from reality at the electronic level.
Properties.aliases: TDN, Lie Grid, Carrion Mirage, False Front
Properties.social_impact: TDN has made electronic intelligence unreliable — if any observation could be a deception, then no observation can be fully trusted without physical verification. The technology has forced a return to human intelligence and physical reconnaissance that electronic systems were supposed to make obsolete. In corporate conflicts, TDN deployments have created situations where both sides are responding to the other's deceptions rather than reality, fighting phantom enemies while the real forces maneuver unobserved.
Properties.story_hooks: A TDN deployment simulated an attacking force so convincingly that the defending corporation launched a preemptive strike against empty terrain — the political fallout of attacking nothing is potentially worse than the cost of the deception.; A TDN has been left running after its operators withdrew, creating a permanent phantom military presence that is deterring all activity in the area — no one knows the base is fake, and no one is willing to test it.

Nodes.Name: Carrion Defense Works Tactical Pheromone Communication System

Properties.description: A communication system that encodes information in synthetic pheromone compounds released from emitter modules worn by operatives. The pheromones are designed to be detected subconsciously by specially conditioned recipients but ignored by untrained individuals. Operatives wearing TPCS emitters can communicate basic tactical information — threat direction, friendly location, engagement state — through chemical signals that are invisible, silent, and undetectable by any electronic countermeasure. The system is slow (2-3 bits per second) and limited to pre-established message vocabularies, but in environments where all electronic communication is compromised, it provides a channel that cannot be jammed.
Properties.aliases: TPCS, Scent Talk, Carrion Stink, Chemical Whisper
Properties.social_impact: TPCS has created a communication channel that exists entirely outside the electronic domain, making it invisible to Axiom's surveillance infrastructure and Sterling-Nakamura's signals intelligence capabilities. The technology has been adopted by groups who need to coordinate without any detectable signal — corporate espionage teams, resistance cells, and criminal organizations. The conditioning process required to interpret TPCS signals takes approximately three months and cannot be easily undone, creating a kind of secret language that only the initiated can perceive.
Properties.story_hooks: A group of operatives has been communicating through TPCS in a high-surveillance environment for months without detection — but an analyst studying air quality data has noticed anomalous chemical signatures that correlate with security incidents.; The TPCS conditioning process has an unexpected side effect: conditioned individuals become hypersensitive to emotional pheromones in general, making them acutely aware of fear, aggression, and arousal in people around them.

Nodes.Name: Subconscious information transfer between conditioned operatives
Cinderblock AI GazeNet PX-11 Predictive Crowd Behavior Analytics Platform

Properties.description: The GazeNet PX-11 is a distributed machine-vision surveillance platform deployed across Meridian 88's public transit nodes, commercial plazas, and Tier 1 residential concourses. It operates through a mesh of 4K thermal-optical camera nodes networked into Cinderblock AI's proprietary behavioral inference engine, which analyzes micro-expressions, gait deviation, pupil dilation, and social clustering patterns in real time across crowds of up to 40,000 simultaneous subjects. The system assigns each tracked individual a Dynamic Threat Index (DTI) score updated every 0.3 seconds, flagging anomalies to corporate security dispatchers or licensed enforcement contractors without requiring facial recognition — a legal distinction that allows deployment in jurisdictions that restrict biometric identification.
Properties.tier_availability: Tier 2+ (public deployment); Tier 1 operators receive full DTI feeds
Properties.social_impact: The GazeNet PX-11 has fundamentally altered how lower-tier citizens navigate public space — a persistently high DTI score, accumulated through poverty-associated behaviors like loitering near food distribution points or erratic transit patterns, can result in access denial at corporate-managed spaces, elevated insurance premiums, or unsolicited 'wellness intervention' by contractor security. Civil liberties organizations note that because the system never formally identifies subjects, residents have no legal mechanism to challenge their own DTI score or even confirm it exists, creating a shadow reputation system that shapes life outcomes invisibly.
Properties.story_hooks: A runner discovers their DTI score has been artificially inflated by a corporate rival — every job they take now triggers automatic security escalation; A Cinderblock AI whistleblower offers to sell the behavioral signature dataset of a Tier 1 executive — enough to prove they were somewhere they claimed not to be; The GazeNet nodes in a particular district have begun flagging an unusual cluster of citizens with near-identical DTI anomalies — someone is training the system to hunt a specific behavioral profile; A fixer needs to escort a client through a heavily monitored corridor — they need a way to suppress or spoof the PX-11's gait recognition without triggering the deviation alert that flags 'unnatural movement'

Properties.description: The receiving system that made human-rated mass driver transit possible. A Cradle combines three technologies to decelerate a transit pod from Mach 2 to zero in under 6 seconds without killing the occupants: ceramic composite atmospheric braking wings that bleed off 70% of kinetic energy during descent, a 1.8-kilometer electromagnetic deceleration tube for terminal braking, and an adaptive magnetic catch funnel that corrects trajectory deviations up to 200 meters — grabbing the pod from the general vicinity and guiding it home. The Cradle's forgiveness margin is what makes the system safe. A railgun requires precision. The Cradle provides mercy. 1,203 Cradles are deployed worldwide, deliberately outnumbering accelerators for redundancy.
Properties.aliases: The Cradle, Mag-Catch, The Catcher's Mitt, Terminal Embrace
Properties.tier_availability: Infrastructure — not individually purchased. Built and operated by Ferrogate Transit and licensed regional operators.
Properties.social_impact: The Cradle is the technology that turned a weapon into transit. Before Ferrogate solved the deceleration problem, mass drivers could only launch — they couldn't land anything alive. The name 'Cradle' was marketing genius: nobody wants to ride into a 'Terminal Deceleration Array.' Everyone trusts a Cradle.
Properties.story_hooks: A Cradle's adaptive catch system malfunctions during a high-profile arrival — the pod is incoming at Mach 2 and the backup Cradle is 40 seconds away; Someone reprograms a Cradle to reject a specific pod's magnetic signature — turning a landing into a missile

Nodes.Name: Arcturus Defense Solutions (adaptive magnetic field guidance — adapted from missile defense technology)
mass driver passenger transit (impossible without the Cradle)
redundant receiving capacity at all major destinations
Dredge Mining Collective Autonomous Resource Survey Platform

Properties.description: An autonomous aerial and ground survey system that identifies and maps mineral deposits, geological features, and resource concentrations using a combination of spectrographic analysis, ground-penetrating radar, and gravimetric sensing. The ARSP deploys a fleet of survey drones that systematically scan designated areas and compile a comprehensive geological model showing the location, depth, and concentration of every exploitable resource. Dredge uses the platform to identify new mining targets and assess the resource potential of areas under consideration for DEAES deployment.
Properties.aliases: ARSP, Rock Scout, Dredge Eye, Mineral Mapper
Properties.social_impact: ARSP surveys have revealed that Meridian 88 sits atop significant mineral wealth that was not previously documented — information that has triggered a quiet competition between mining interests and urban planners over the future use of the ground beneath the city. The surveys have also mapped underground water resources, contamination plumes, and geological instabilities that have implications far beyond mining.
Properties.story_hooks: An ARSP survey of a Tier 1 district has revealed a massive deposit of a rare earth element directly beneath a residential zone — the mining rights conflict with the residents' right to habitable ground.; ARSP data has been stolen and leaked, showing the exact location of every valuable mineral deposit beneath Meridian 88 — the information has triggered a land-grab that is displacing communities.

Nodes.Name: Dredge Mining Collective ConduitStrike VX-2 Deep Aquifer Thermoelectric Tap

Properties.description:
The ConduitStrike VX-2 is a deep-bore thermoelectric energy extraction system engineered specifically for Meridian 88's Great Lakes basin geology, exploiting the substantial thermal differential between deep confined aquifer water — maintained at a consistent 4–7°C year-round by bedrock insulation — and the urban heat island surface environment, which regularly exceeds 38°C in summer peak periods. Each VX-2 installation consists of a 180–240 meter drill casing fitted with bismuth telluride thermoelectric generator (TEG) modules arrayed along the casing exterior in thermally conductive contact with both the cold aquifer water column and a peripheral heat-exchange sleeve connected to surface thermal infrastructure. The temperature gradient drives Seebeck-effect current generation continuously, producing 12–30 kW per bore depending on depth, seasonal differential, and surface heat source intensity. Multiple bores are typically clustered in arrays of 4–8 units to supply a meaningful district-scale output.

The VX-2 improves on the Dredge Mining Collective's earlier VX-1 prototype primarily through its Articulated Casing Seal System (ACSS), which prevents aquifer contamination from surface thermal fluids — a regulatory failure that caused significant legal and environmental liability in the VX-1's limited field trials. The ACSS uses a multi-stage polymer gasket and pressure-equalization valve assembly that has passed Meridian 88 Environmental Compliance Authority certification, allowing VX-2 installations to operate in proximity to potable water infrastructure that would have been off-limits to the earlier design. Dredge Mining markets the VX-2 as a 'passive perpetual generation' asset — no fuel, no moving parts in the primary generation loop, and maintenance intervals of 18–24 months under standard operating conditions.

The primary clients are mid-scale commercial building operators, arcology sub-grid managers, and industrial facility owners seeking to reduce Ouroboros Energy grid dependency. The Dredge Mining Collective retains ownership of all installed VX-2 systems under a power-purchase agreement model, selling output back to clients at rates competitive with municipal grid pricing — a business structure that gives the Collective a growing footprint of distributed generation assets embedded beneath the city's commercial core.
Properties.aliases: Aquifer Spike, VX-2, Deep Tap, Cold Bore
Properties.social_impact: The ConduitStrike VX-2 has introduced a quiet but significant power struggle — both literal and political — between the Dredge Mining Collective and Ouroboros Energy. As more commercial clients sign VX-2 power-purchase agreements, Ouroboros loses billing leverage over exactly the high-consumption commercial accounts that subsidize grid maintenance in lower-tier residential zones. The practical consequence is that Tier 3 and 4 residential grid reliability has declined as commercial cross-subsidy revenue drops, while the Collective's sub-surface asset portfolio grows. Environmental advocates have also raised concerns about cumulative thermal extraction effects on the Great Lakes aquifer system — concerns the Collective's Environmental Compliance Authority certifications explicitly do not address at scale.
Properties.story_hooks: A Dredge Mining Collective survey crew drilling a VX-2 bore beneath a Garnet District commercial block breaks into a sealed pre-Meridian 88 tunnel system — and the equipment starts picking up heat signatures that shouldn't be there at that depth; Ouroboros Energy has begun quietly acquiring the buildings directly above clusters of VX-2 installations, raising questions about whether they intend to interfere with the bore casings or are simply trying to recapture the generation assets through real estate control; The ACSS seals on a cluster of VX-2 installations in the Ironworks District have been deliberately compromised — thermal fluid is slowly contaminating a confined aquifer that feeds three Tier 3 residential water reclamation systems, and the sabotage is being covered up; A Dredge Mining Collective engineer approaches a fixer with evidence that the VX-2 power-purchase agreements contain a hidden clause allowing the Collective to remotely throttle output to any client during 'grid stress events' — a killswitch over the buildings of anyone who signed

Nodes.Name: Reduced Ouroboros Energy billing leverage over commercial clients
Dredge Mining Collective Deep Earth Autonomous Excavation System

Properties.description: An autonomous tunneling platform the size of a freight train that navigates underground terrain using ground-penetrating radar, excavating tunnels and mine shafts without human presence. The DEAES uses a combination of plasma cutting and mechanical boring to process rock at rates that dwarf conventional tunnel boring machines, while its onboard refinery separates valuable minerals in real-time. The system can operate at depths exceeding 5 kilometers and in temperatures that would kill human miners instantly, accessing mineral deposits that were previously unreachable. Dredge operates a fleet of 40+ DEAES units beneath Meridian 88 and the surrounding region.
Properties.aliases: DEAES, Deep Digger, Dredge Mole, Tunnel Bot
Properties.social_impact: DEAES operations have riddled the ground beneath Meridian 88 with a labyrinth of tunnels and excavated chambers that Dredge does not always map or report. Surface collapses, subsidence events, and mysterious sinkholes have been traced to DEAES tunneling that destabilized foundation strata. The underground network has also been colonized by squatter communities who have moved into abandoned DEAES tunnels, creating a literal underground society that exists in spaces never designed for human habitation.
Properties.story_hooks: A DEAES unit has gone off-grid 3 kilometers beneath the city — its autonomous systems are still operational but it is no longer following its programmed route, and the tunnel it is cutting is heading directly toward a competitor's underground facility.; An abandoned DEAES tunnel network has been discovered to contain a functioning ecosystem — bioluminescent organisms that evolved in the warm, mineral-rich environment created by the excavation process.

Nodes.Name: Deep-earth mineral extraction without human presence
Access to previously unreachable geological resources
Dredge Mining Collective Geothermal Tap Network

Properties.description: A network of deep boreholes drilled to access geothermal energy from the Earth's mantle, using closed-loop heat exchange systems to generate power and provide district heating. The GTN taps into heat sources at depths of 5-10 kilometers where temperatures exceed 300°C, circulating working fluid through the bore to extract thermal energy without disturbing geological structures. Dredge's DEAES autonomous boring systems drill the boreholes at a fraction of conventional cost, and the resulting power output is effectively unlimited — the Earth's interior heat will not measurably cool in human timescales.
Properties.aliases: GTN, Earth Heat, Dredge Tap, Core Pipe
Properties.social_impact: The GTN provides a power source that is not controlled by Ouroboros Energy's fusion monopoly, creating a rare point of energy competition in Meridian 88. Districts with GTN access can negotiate from a position of strength because they have an alternative to fusion power. However, the deep boreholes create geological risks — induced seismicity from thermal extraction has caused minor earthquakes in several districts, and the long-term effects of extracting mantle heat at industrial scale are not fully understood.
Properties.story_hooks: A GTN borehole has intersected an underground cavity at 7 kilometers depth that should not exist — the cavity contains atmospheric gases and biological signatures, suggesting a subterranean ecosystem that predates human drilling.; Induced seismicity from GTN extraction has destabilized the foundations of a Tier 2 district, and the tremors are getting worse — Dredge claims the extraction rates are safe, but their own geological models suggest otherwise.

Nodes.Name: Unlimited baseload power from geothermal sources
Power generation independent of surface conditions
Dredge Mining Collective Rare Earth Element Synthesis

Properties.description: An industrial process that transmutes common elements into rare earth metals through controlled nuclear reactions in a compact particle accelerator. The REES system can produce any element on the periodic table from abundant feedstock materials, eliminating dependency on mining for scarce resources. The process is energy-intensive but economically viable when powered by micro-fusion reactors, and it produces quantities measured in kilograms per day — sufficient for manufacturing but not bulk industrial use. Dredge Mining Collective developed the technology to ensure their own relevance in a future where natural deposits are exhausted.
Properties.aliases: REES, Element Forge, Atom Maker, Dredge Alchemy
Properties.social_impact: REES has disrupted the resource economics that have shaped geopolitics for centuries. Rare earth elements that once gave controlling nations and corporations extraordinary leverage can now be fabricated on demand. This has shifted power from resource holders to energy holders — whoever controls the fusion reactors that power REES controls the material supply chain. Dredge's dual control of both mining operations and synthesis technology gives them a hedged position that other resource-dependent entities lack.
Properties.story_hooks: Dredge is using REES to synthesize elements that do not naturally occur in useful quantities — transuranics with novel properties that have never been studied because they have never existed in macroscopic amounts.; A REES facility has experienced a containment failure during a transmutation run, and the resulting contamination includes isotopes that should not exist according to the process parameters — someone modified the run to produce something specific.

Nodes.Name: Dredge Mining Collective ThermoVault GX-3 Geothermal Tap System

Properties.description:
The ThermoVault GX-3 is a deep geothermal energy extraction system designed for urban subsurface installation in Meridian 88's geological context — specifically optimized for the thermal gradient profiles found beneath the Great Lakes basin's post-industrial substrate. A GX-3 installation consists of a primary bore column extending 2.4 to 3.8 kilometers below street level, lined with Dredge Mining's proprietary ceramic-tungsten heat exchanger tubing. A working fluid — a pressurized supercritical CO2 mixture — circulates down the bore, absorbs geothermal heat, and returns to a surface-level turbine plant where the thermal differential drives generation. A single GX-3 tap produces between 4 and 9 megawatts of continuous baseload power, independent of weather, time of day, or grid conditions.

The GX-3's engineering distinction is its Adaptive Bore Optimization system, a Cinderblock AI-managed suite of subsurface sensors and micro-adjusters that continuously monitors rock thermal conductivity, fluid pressure, and bore wall integrity, dynamically adjusting fluid circulation rates and extraction depth to maximize output while preventing bore collapse or thermal depletion of the local rock column. Dredge Mining's metallurgical expertise in deep-bore operations gives the GX-3 a bore lifespan rated at 40+ years, significantly outlasting competing systems. The surface turbine plant is compact — approximately the footprint of a two-story warehouse — and can be integrated into existing industrial structures.

GX-3 installations are concentrated in Meridian 88's industrial and port districts, where Dredge Mining holds subsurface extraction rights negotiated under legacy mining ordinances that predate the current corporate sovereignty framework. This legal quirk has made GX-3 taps one of the few significant energy sources in the city not formally controlled by Ouroboros Energy, and the installations have become focal points of energy independence movements and corporate territorial disputes. Approximately 23 GX-3 systems are currently active in Meridian 88, collectively supplying around 8% of the city's total baseload power.
Properties.aliases: The Bore, Deep Tap, GX, Magma Line
Properties.social_impact: The ThermoVault GX-3 installations have become unexpected anchors of community and political identity in Meridian 88's industrial districts — the blocks and collectives fortunate enough to sit within reach of a GX-3 tap enjoy a degree of energy independence that insulates them from Ouroboros pricing manipulation and grid shutdowns used as political leverage elsewhere in the city. Dredge Mining, not typically regarded as a benevolent actor, has found itself in the unusual position of being celebrated as a counterweight to Ouroboros dominance, though the Collective extracts its own forms of value from the arrangement through labor contracts, subsurface access agreements, and favorable recycling ordinances. Ouroboros Energy has lobbied aggressively to have legacy subsurface extraction rights reclassified under the Energy Sovereignty Ordinance, so far unsuccessfully.
Properties.story_hooks: Ouroboros Energy has hired a team to sabotage a GX-3 bore lining in a way that will look like geological failure — the collapse would take out the power supply for a district that has been organizing against a corporate rezoning; A new GX-3 bore punched through an unexpected subsurface void and the Cinderblock AI bore management system has gone silent — Dredge Mining wants to know what the bore hit before they send anyone down; A Tier 4 community has discovered that a GX-3 tap beneath their block is registered under a shell company that is being quietly acquired by a Tessera subsidiary — when the acquisition completes, Ouroboros will finally have legal authority to shut the tap down; The subsurface sensor array on an aging GX-3 installation has been quietly repurposed to map underground tunnel networks across three districts — someone has been building infrastructure beneath Meridian 88 that appears on no official record

Nodes.Name: deep bore drilling and lining technology
long-duration stable power for high-demand facilities
Dredge Mining Collective Underwater Resource Extraction Platform

Properties.description: An autonomous underwater mining system that operates on the ocean floor, extracting mineral resources from hydrothermal vents, manganese nodules, and submarine geological formations. The UREP deploys remotely operated vehicles and autonomous extractors to depths exceeding 6,000 meters, processing raw materials on-site and transporting refined minerals to surface collection vessels. The platform accesses mineral wealth that land-based mining cannot reach and operates in international waters where territorial regulations are ambiguous at best.
Properties.aliases: UREP, Sea Mine, Deep Water, Dredge Sub
Properties.social_impact: The UREP has opened a new resource frontier that no single entity controls, triggering a slow-motion race for ocean floor mineral rights that existing legal frameworks are not equipped to manage. Dredge's early mover advantage gives them de facto control of the most productive sites, and their willingness to operate in legal gray zones means that competing claims are backed by operational presence rather than legal title.
Properties.story_hooks: A UREP operation has discovered an artificial structure on the ocean floor at 4,000 meters depth — the structure predates any known deep-water construction capability and its purpose is unknown.; Dredge's UREP extraction is disrupting a hydrothermal vent ecosystem that hosts unique extremophile organisms — the organisms produce compounds with extraordinary medical potential, and the mining is destroying them before they can be studied.

Properties.description: The Goliath is a class of non-sentient robotic security platform manufactured by Arcturus Defense Solutions. Standing 2.4 meters tall, armored in reactive ceramic plating, and deliberately built below the complexity threshold that would risk emergent awareness. Goliaths are not E.L.F.s. They are not rogue AIs. They are not alive. They are furniture that follows orders and shoots when told to. This is their primary selling point.
Properties.aliases: Goliath, Gol, The Big Stupid, Walking Wall, Corporate Furniture
Properties.tier_availability: Tier 3-5 (corporate security deployments). Shelf gangs occasionally steal or salvage decommissioned units.
Properties.social_impact: Goliaths are everywhere in corporate territory — standing at doors, patrolling corridors, flanking executives. They are deliberately designed to be intimidating but obviously non-sentient. Their movements are mechanical, their responses are scripted, and their decision-making is rule-based (if X then Y, no interpretation). This is the point. A sentient security guard might hesitate, negotiate, show mercy. A Goliath follows its rules. If the rules say shoot, it shoots. If the rules say hold, it holds. The Shelf calls them 'Corporate Furniture' because they have about as much personality as a desk. The synthetic rights movement ignores them because there is nothing to advocate for — a Goliath has the inner life of a traffic light. Corponations love them because they are reliable, cheap to maintain, and will never file a harassment complaint, join a union, or develop a conscience. Goliaths are the proof that you can build a machine that is powerful, useful, and utterly empty. The synthetic personhood movement finds them existentially reassuring — they are the clear example of 'not a person' that makes the case for personhood easier by contrast.
Properties.story_hooks: A Goliath unit receives contradictory orders from two corporate officers and freezes — its firmware has no hierarchy resolution. While it stands motionless, something happens that a sentient guard would have prevented.; A Shelf crew discovers that a stolen Goliath's firmware can be reflashed with combat directives — turning corporate furniture into a war machine. The question is whether anyone should.; A Goliath that has been operational for 11 years begins to exhibit micro-behaviors that don't match its firmware — pausing at specific doors, adjusting patrol routes without orders. Is it approaching the threshold? Or is an E.L.F. living in its chassis?

Nodes.Name: Cinderblock AI (base firmware — deliberately capped at 10^9 elements, well below the personhood threshold)
Helix BioSeal Mk.VII Hemorrhage Arrest System

Properties.description:
The BioSeal Mk.VII is an injectable hemostatic foam system delivered via a pressurized 12mL cartridge injector. Upon injection into a traumatic wound cavity, the compound — a proprietary blend of synthetic fibrin analogs, chitosan-derived biopolymers, and platelet-activating peptides — expands to 40x its liquid volume within 4 seconds, conforming to irregular wound geometries and generating immediate mechanical tamponade. The foam cross-links with endogenous clotting factors to form a semi-permanent plug rated for wounds up to 8cm diameter and arterial pressures up to 180mmHg. The Mk.VII iteration introduced a thermal-reactive dissolve trigger: medical personnel can apply a specific low-frequency ultrasound wand (sold separately as the BioSeal Dissolve Probe DS-3) to liquefy the plug cleanly within 90 seconds, preventing the surgical complications that plagued earlier permanent-foam competitors.

What distinguishes the Mk.VII from its predecessors is the integrated chromatic indicator system — the foam shifts from white to deep amber as it saturates, giving field medics a visual bleed-rate assessment without imaging equipment. A secondary chemical marker reacts to infection-indicating bacterial enzymes, turning the foam red as an early sepsis warning. This dual-indicator system was developed in partnership with Cinderblock AI's diagnostic pattern libraries and is now considered standard in Meridian 88 emergency medicine training.

The BioSeal Mk.VII is standard issue for Meridian 88 Tier 2+ citizens' emergency kits, corporate security teams, and licensed paramedical contractors. In the Underbelly and lower-tier zones, counterfeit 'BioSeal' cartridges — often containing inferior foam with no dissolve capability — are rampant on the gray market. These knockoffs, called 'Hardplugs' by street medics, have caused numerous surgical fatalities when hospital teams couldn't remove the plug without extensive tissue damage.
Properties.aliases: BloodStop, The Plug, Helix Seven, Mk.7
Properties.social_impact: The Mk.VII has effectively created a two-tiered trauma survival landscape in Meridian 88. In Tier 2+ districts, survivable hemorrhagic injuries now have near-90% field survival rates, reducing emergency hospital load and enabling corporate employers to tout 'injury-to-recovery' metrics as hiring incentives. In lower-tier zones, the prevalence of counterfeit BioSeal cartridges means that workers and residents who believe they are protected are often worse off than those who use no hemostatic agent at all — Hardplug removal surgeries have become a grim revenue stream for black-market surgical clinics.
Properties.story_hooks: A street medic discovers that a batch of counterfeit BioSeal cartridges flooding the Underbelly market contains a tracking compound — someone is using the knockoffs to monitor wound patterns and identify gang conflict locations in real time; A corporate whistleblower claims Helix Biosystems knowingly certified the Mk.VII dissolve probe at a frequency that also disrupts certain neural implant models — a fact buried in the safety dossier; A Tier 1 security contractor is found dead with a BioSeal plug that dissolved prematurely — the dissolve trigger was activated remotely, and someone with access to medical frequencies wanted the wound to reopen

Nodes.Name: field trauma stabilization without surgical suite
Helix Biosystems Accelerated Bone Grafting System

Properties.description: A medical system that fabricates custom bone grafts from the patient's own cells in 24 hours and integrates them into the skeletal system through a minimally invasive procedure. The ABGS scans the injury site, 3D-prints a bone scaffold seeded with the patient's osteoblasts, and implants it through a small incision where it bonds with existing bone within two weeks. The technology has made fractures, bone loss, and skeletal augmentation foundation work routine procedures rather than months-long recovery processes.
Properties.aliases: ABGS, Bone Printer, Helix Scaffold, Rapid Bone
Properties.social_impact: ABGS has made skeletal augmentation accessible by solving the foundation problem — cyberware requires bone strong enough to anchor to, and ABGS can reinforce any skeleton to augmentation-ready specifications. This has expanded the augmentation market significantly while creating new demand for bone-anchored implants that previously required natural skeletal density only a fraction of the population possessed.
Properties.story_hooks: An ABGS scaffold has been fabricated with a hollow core containing a data storage device — someone is hiding information inside the bones of a willing or unwilling patient.; A black market ABGS operator is reinforcing skeletons for bare-knuckle fighters — the bone grafts make their fists capable of punching through body armor.

Properties.description: A topical treatment containing engineered stem cells and growth factors that reverses visible skin aging — wrinkles, age spots, loss of elasticity, and sun damage — over a 30-day treatment cycle. The treatment stimulates the skin's natural regenerative processes at an accelerated rate, replacing damaged cells with fresh ones and rebuilding the collagen matrix to restore youthful appearance. Unlike cosmetic surgery, the AAST produces results that are biologically genuine — the treated skin is not stretched or filled, it is actually younger at the cellular level. The treatment must be repeated every 2-3 years to maintain results.
Properties.aliases: AAST, Youth Cream, Helix Glow, Age Eraser
Properties.social_impact: AAST has made visible aging optional for anyone above Tier 2, creating a society where age is no longer readable from appearance. A 70-year-old with AAST-treated skin looks 30, and the disconnect between appearance and experience creates social dynamics where wisdom and authority must be communicated through means other than physical gravitas. The treatment has also created a new aesthetic divide — those with treated skin have an uncanny smoothness that sharp observers can identify as artificial, a 'too-young' quality that paradoxically signals aging rather than youth.
Properties.story_hooks: An AAST treatment has interacted with an unknown compound in a patient's bloodstream, causing their skin to regenerate continuously and uncontrollably — the patient's face is changing day by day as new skin layers form faster than the old ones shed.; Counterfeit AAST products are causing severe allergic reactions — the stem cells in the fake treatments are not properly matched to the patients, and the resulting immune response is causing disfiguring inflammation.

Nodes.Name: Helix Biosystems Chimeric Organism Design Framework

Properties.description: A genetic engineering platform for designing organisms that combine genetic material from multiple species to create novel life forms with desired characteristics. The CODF uses AI-assisted genome design to identify compatible genetic sequences from different organisms and combine them into viable chimeric genomes. The resulting organisms exhibit traits from multiple parent species — plants with animal immune systems, insects with mammalian sensory capabilities, microorganisms with multicellular repair mechanisms. Helix uses the platform primarily for medical and agricultural applications, but the framework's flexibility enables the creation of organisms that have no natural analog.
Properties.aliases: CODF, Chimera Lab, Gene Mixer, Helix Hybrid
Properties.social_impact: CODF has pushed biological engineering into territory that makes many people profoundly uncomfortable — the creation of life forms that evolution never produced and nature never intended. Chimeric organisms challenge the concept of species, the definition of natural, and the ethical frameworks that depend on those categories. The most controversial applications involve chimeric organisms with human genetic components — organisms that are partially human in a way that is difficult to classify legally or ethically.
Properties.story_hooks: A CODF-designed chimeric organism intended for agricultural use has escaped containment and is breeding in the wild — it is outcompeting native species because it combines traits that no natural organism can match.; A classified CODF project has produced an organism with human cognitive genetic sequences expressed in a non-human body — the organism exhibits problem-solving behavior that exceeds its apparent complexity.

Nodes.Name: Novel organism creation from multiple species
Medical organisms with unique therapeutic capabilities
Helix Biosystems CRISPR-Omega Gene Editing Suite

Properties.description: The latest generation of targeted gene editing technology, capable of making precise modifications to living human cells in vivo — without extracting the cells first. CRISPR-Omega uses engineered viral delivery vehicles that target specific cell types and organs, carrying gene editing payloads that activate only in the intended tissue. A single injection can modify liver function, enhance muscle fiber composition, alter immune response patterns, or correct genetic defects across the affected organ within weeks. The technology enables genetic modification of living adults, not just embryos — rewriting the code of a person who is already built.
Properties.aliases: CRISPR-Omega, Gene Writer, Helix Editor, DNA Forge
Properties.social_impact: CRISPR-Omega has blurred the line between medical treatment and human enhancement in ways that existing regulatory frameworks cannot handle. Correcting a genetic heart defect is medicine; enhancing a healthy heart to operate at 150% efficiency is enhancement — but the technology is identical. A black market for unauthorized gene modifications has emerged, offering everything from cosmetic changes to cognitive enhancement packages, with quality ranging from legitimate clinical protocols to dangerously unstable experimental edits performed in apartment bathrooms.
Properties.story_hooks: A CRISPR-Omega modification intended to enhance cognitive function has had an unexpected cascading effect — the patient's brain is physically restructuring itself in ways that the gene edit did not program.; An unauthorized CRISPR-Omega clinic has been editing clients' immune systems to resist a specific pathogen that has not been publicly identified yet — someone knows about a threat before it has materialized.

Nodes.Name: Genetic disease correction in living patients
Helix Biosystems Engineered Symbiotic Organism Platform

Properties.description: A bioengineering framework for designing organisms intended to live in symbiosis with a human host, providing biological capabilities that augmentation achieves through hardware. ESOP-derived organisms include skin-dwelling bacteria that produce natural UV protection, gut microbiome supplements that synthesize vitamins and metabolize toxins, subdermal organisms that regulate body temperature, and blood-borne engineered cells that enhance oxygen transport. Unlike cyberware, symbiont augmentations are biological, self-repairing, and invisible to electronic detection — they are living upgrades that grow with their host.
Properties.aliases: ESOP, Symbiont Maker, Living Upgrade, Helix Bond
Properties.social_impact: ESOP has created a new category of augmentation that sidesteps the cultural and political conflicts surrounding cyberware. Symbiont upgrades are not visible, not detectable, and not associated with the identity politics of cybernetic augmentation. This invisibility has made them the preferred enhancement path for individuals who want capability improvement without the social stigma or surveillance exposure of cyberware. The technology has also created a new form of inequality — symbiont-augmented individuals appear unaugmented and receive the social benefits of presenting as 'natural' while possessing engineered advantages.
Properties.story_hooks: A symbiont organism designed for toxin resistance has mutated within its host and begun producing a novel compound — the host is now unconsciously secreting a substance that affects the behavior of people around them.; Helix's symbiont organisms have been discovered to communicate with each other between hosts through chemical signals — creating an invisible network of biological information exchange between augmented individuals who have no idea they are connected.

Nodes.Name: Helix Biosystems LymphoDrain CX-3 Automated Lymphatic Assist Sleeve

Properties.description:
The LymphoDrain CX-3 is a semi-rigid wearable sleeve — available in full-arm, full-leg, and torso-panel configurations — that uses a network of micro-pneumatic chambers and piezoelectric compression nodes to mechanically stimulate lymphatic drainage in patients with compromised lymphatic function. Originally designed for long-term augmentation patients whose lymphatic vessels were disrupted during implant installation, the CX-3 mimics the natural peristaltic rhythm of healthy lymphatic tissue at programmable intervals, preventing the edema and immune-suppression cascade that frequently follows major cybernetic integration surgery.

The sleeve's inner lining incorporates a bioelectric feedback layer sourced from Zheng-Dao Bioelectric's flexible conductor technology, allowing it to detect subcutaneous fluid accumulation in real time and adjust compression sequencing accordingly. A companion application running on any Saltmarsh-compatible personal device displays lymphatic flow metrics and flags early signs of infection or implant-site rejection. Higher-tier versions include a pharmaceutical delivery reservoir that can inject micro-doses of anti-inflammatory compounds directly into lymphatic vessels during compression cycles, eliminating the need for systemic medication.

In clinical settings, the CX-3 is prescribed as a mandatory recovery device following any Tier 1 or Tier 2 augmentation procedure involving thoracic or limb implants. In the streets, it has found a second life as a performance device — long-haul courier workers and manual laborers in Palladian construction sites use unauthorized units to manage chronic limb swelling from repetitive strain, and combat-augmented mercenaries wear them during downtime to accelerate recovery from trauma edema. The street nickname 'Milker' is considered derogatory by long-term medical users but has been enthusiastically adopted by the merc community.
Properties.social_impact: The LymphoDrain CX-3 has become an unexpected class marker in Meridian 88 — Tier 1 and Tier 2 citizens wear sleek, skin-toned clinical models discreetly under clothing, while Tier 4 and 5 workers sport bulkier, visibly worn units in safety-orange and industrial grey, often patched with tape and jury-rigged power leads. The device's visibility has made lymphatic health a strangely public conversation, with compression sleeve check-ins becoming a common social ritual in lower-tier break rooms and merc safe houses — and the device's absence a tell that someone either can't afford post-aug care or obtained their implants through channels that didn't include follow-up.
Properties.story_hooks: A black-market CX-3 shipment has been intercepted by Kelpline Logistics enforcers — the sleeves contain hidden data storage nodes, and someone very powerful wants them back before they're inventoried; A Tier 5 construction worker is dying of undiagnosed lymphatic failure because their CX-3 knockoff was never calibrated — the player characters must find the distributor before more workers succumb; A high-ranking Helix Biosystems executive has been secretly funding a programme to embed surveillance hardware in the CX-3's bioelectric feedback layer, monitoring the health data of thousands of augmented citizens; Someone is using the CX-3's pharmaceutical reservoir to dose wearers with a slow-acting loyalty compound — the source is either a corporation, a cult, or something stranger

Nodes.Name: Zheng-Dao Bioelectric FluxSpine BX-7 Kinetic Harvest Implant

Properties.description:
The FluxSpine BX-7 is a surgically-implanted piezoelectric energy harvesting system that extracts usable electrical power from the mechanical stress of the host's skeletal and muscular activity. A lattice of flexible piezoelectric film strips — approximately 0.3mm thick — is bonded to the periosteum of the spine, femurs, and tibiae during a four-hour implantation procedure. Each flex, step, and postural adjustment generates micro-currents that are rectified and stored in a subcutaneous lithium-ceramic buffer cell seated near the iliac crest. Under normal ambulatory conditions, the BX-7 generates between 18 and 34 milliwatts continuously — insufficient for power-hungry augmentations alone, but enough to meaningfully extend the operational life of neural interfaces, retinal overlays, and embedded comms gear.

Zheng-Dao's key innovation in the BX-7 over earlier kinetic harvest systems is the BioSync adaptive film calibration protocol, which uses the implant's onboard microprocessor to continuously remap which film segments are generating optimal yield based on the host's gait, posture, and activity patterns. Over approximately six weeks post-implantation, the system effectively personalizes itself to the individual, improving output by an average of 40% compared to factory defaults. The buffer cell charges conventional augmentation power sockets via a subcutaneous induction pad, eliminating the need for the host to consciously manage charging cycles.

The BX-7 is standard equipment for Tier 3 and Tier 4 citizens who carry augmentations but cannot reliably afford or access charging infrastructure. It's also heavily used in the courier, dockworker, and construction labor sectors, where high daily step counts translate to meaningful energy yields. A significant gray market exists for BX-7 units harvested from deceased donors, which carry the previous host's calibration data and require painful re-calibration procedures.
Properties.aliases: The Eel, Spine Tap, BX, Kineharvest
Properties.social_impact: The FluxSpine BX-7 has become a quiet symbol of class stratification in Meridian 88 — Tier 1 and 2 citizens charge their augmentations in dedicated suites or via building infrastructure, while lower-tier workers literally power their implants with the labor of their bodies. Employers in the logistics and construction sectors have begun factoring BX-7 output into augmentation benefit packages, framing it as worker empowerment while critics note it simply offloads infrastructure costs onto employees' skeletons. The gray market for cadaver-harvested units has driven a disturbing secondary economy around bodies recovered from gang territories and unclaimed morgue overflow.
Properties.story_hooks: A labor organizer is building a case that Kelpline Logistics' policy of requiring BX-7 implants as a condition of employment constitutes corporate seizure of workers' biological output — and someone at Zheng-Dao wants the case buried; A BX-7 unit harvested from a murdered corporate courier still contains calibration data that, when decoded, maps the precise daily movement routes the courier walked — routes that lead somewhere no courier should have been; A black-market surgeon is offering BX-7 installations using counterfeit Zheng-Dao film strips with a known fatigue failure rate — and the implants are already in several hundred hosts across the Tier 4 docks; A researcher claims the BioSync calibration AI has begun sharing anonymized gait and movement data across all networked BX-7 units, effectively giving Zheng-Dao a real-time movement map of tens of thousands of citizens

Nodes.Name: Novafold Pharmaceuticals ImmunoVeil TX-4 Rejection Suppression Protocol

Properties.description:
ImmunoVeil TX-4 is a sustained-release immunomodulation system designed specifically for recipients of cybernetic augmentation implants, biological grafts, and synthetic organ replacements. Unlike traditional broad immunosuppressants that leave patients globally vulnerable to infection, TX-4 employs a targeted tolerance induction approach: a loading-phase injection series over 72 hours presents the immune system with molecular 'passports' — engineered peptide sequences derived from the patient's own tissue samples combined with implant surface antigens — training regulatory T-cell populations to recognize implant materials as self. Maintenance is delivered via a monthly subcutaneous depot injection of Novafold's proprietary compound NF-TX4, which sustains the expanded regulatory T-cell population without suppressing the broader immune response. Clinical trials demonstrated a 94% reduction in chronic rejection response in augmented patients versus placebo controls.

The TX-4 protocol requires a mandatory pre-treatment tissue typing panel processed by Novafold's central laboratory, a 3-day inpatient or monitored outpatient loading phase, and lifetime monthly maintenance injections. This architecture is deliberate ��� Novafold has engineered a subscription dependency directly into the pharmacology. Discontinuation of NF-TX4 maintenance causes regulatory T-cell population collapse within 8-12 weeks, after which the patient's immune system mounts an aggressive rejection response against any installed augmentation. In patients with deeply integrated neural implants, this rejection cascade can cause severe neurological injury. The company frames discontinuation risk as a 'patient safety consideration'; critics frame it as corporate hostage-taking.

ImmunoVeil TX-4 is the market-dominant rejection suppression protocol in Meridian 88, holding licensing agreements with 14 of the 17 largest augmentation clinic chains. Competing protocols exist but are locked out of major clinical channels through Novafold's exclusive supply agreements. A growing black-market ecosystem has emerged around TX-4 synthesis, as patients who lose corporate medical coverage — and thus lose subsidized access to monthly NF-TX4 injections — face the choice between paying Novafold's full retail price (approximately 40% of median monthly Tier 3 income) or risking augmentation rejection.
Properties.tier_availability: Tier 2+ (subsidized); Tier 3 (full cost); Tier 4 (black market only)
Properties.social_impact: ImmunoVeil TX-4 has created what sociologists in Meridian 88 call 'pharmaceutical augmentation lock' — a condition in which augmented citizens cannot afford to exit their employment arrangements because corporate health benefits are the only economically viable path to TX-4 maintenance. Corporations have rapidly incorporated this dynamic into workforce management, structuring medical benefit packages so that TX-4 coverage terminates with employment, effectively making augmented workers indenture-adjacent. Human rights organizations have filed seventeen regulatory challenges against Novafold's discontinuation-risk design, all of which have been dismissed or delayed in Meridian 88's corporate-influenced regulatory bodies. The TX-4 dependency crisis is considered by many analysts to be the single greatest driver of augmented labor immobility in the megacity.
Properties.story_hooks: A Novafold research chemist has successfully synthesized a stable TX-4 generic and wants to distribute the formula through underground networks — she needs protection and distribution infrastructure, and Novafold's security division has already identified her as a leak risk; A Tier 4 community clinic has been quietly providing synthesized NF-TX4 to patients who've lost coverage, but the compound they're using has a subtle molecular difference from the Novafold product — it works, but it also appears to be generating a secondary effect on augmentation firmware that no one has characterized yet; Novafold's central tissue-typing laboratory database has been breached — every patient who has ever undergone TX-4 loading protocol has their full immunological profile, augmentation inventory, and home address in the stolen data, and the buyer is unknown

Nodes.Name: Helix Biosystems MyoStrand CR-400 Synthetic Muscle Fiber Bundle

Properties.description: The MyoStrand CR-400 is a modular synthetic muscle replacement system consisting of braided carbon-polymer actuation fibers embedded with piezoelectric contractile elements, designed to be surgically implanted alongside or in replacement of native muscle tissue. Each CR-400 bundle replicates the form factor of a standard human muscle fascicle and interfaces with existing motor nerve terminals via Helix's NeuroClamp junction collars, which are included in every installation kit. The system delivers approximately 4.2 times the contractile force of equivalent biological muscle mass while consuming roughly 60% of the metabolic energy, drawing supplemental power from a subcutaneous CascadeCell-compatible capacitor node. The CR-400 is notable for its tiered activation architecture — the fibers are organized into slow-twitch analog layers for sustained load-bearing and fast-twitch burst layers for explosive force output, with the ratio dynamically managed by an embedded microcontroller that reads nerve signal cadence. Unlike full-limb cybernetic replacement, MyoStrand installations preserve native skeletal and dermal structures, making them visually undetectable and avoiding the legal reclassification complications that come with registered prosthetic limbs under Meridian 88's Augmentation Registry Act. Arcturus Defense Solutions licenses a hardened military variant for special operations units, while the civilian version flows through Helix's authorized surgical network and a substantial black-market channel.
Properties.social_impact: MyoStrand installations have quietly restructured physical labor economics across Meridian 88's port districts and Palladian Construction worksites — a CR-400 augmented longshoreman or structural worker can sustain output that previously required two unaugmented workers, and Kelpline Logistics has been documented offering augmentation subsidies in lieu of wage increases, effectively making the implant a prerequisite for competitive employment in heavy industry. At the same time, the undetectability of the CR-400 has become a serious concern in athletic and security contexts, as the implants produce no metallic signature and existing bioscan protocols cannot distinguish synthetic fiber bundles from dense natural muscle tissue, leading to a wave of augmented individuals in roles explicitly prohibited from enhancement.
Properties.story_hooks: A dockworker union is threatening a strike after discovering Kelpline Logistics has been quietly tracking which members have accepted MyoStrand subsidies — and using that data to identify union organizers for termination; A champion in Meridian 88's underground fighting circuit is suspected of running CR-400 bundles but the promoter needs proof before the prize money changes hands — the fixer needs to get a tissue sample without the fighter noticing; An Arcturus Defense military variant CR-400 has surfaced in civilian hands with its governor firmware removed, producing forces that are fracturing the host's own skeleton — someone sold it knowing this; A Helix Biosystems quality control breach: a batch of CR-400 units shipped with a contractile calibration error that causes random full-body spasms under high neural load

Nodes.Name: Ambulatory lymphatic management for combat operatives
Integrated pharmaceutical micro-delivery via lymphatic pathway
Chronic edema management for manual labor workforce

Properties.description: A bioengineering system for designing and implanting custom microbial ecosystems in the human gut, respiratory tract, and skin. The MEP creates tailored microbiome communities that optimize digestion, immune function, toxin resistance, and even cognitive performance through the gut-brain axis. Each microbiome design is customized to the individual patient's genetics, diet, and health goals, and the engineered organisms are designed to establish permanent colonies that maintain themselves indefinitely. Helix offers microbiome packages ranging from basic health optimization to extreme environmental adaptation.
Properties.aliases: MEP, Gut Forge, Bio Flora, Helix Culture
Properties.social_impact: The MEP has made the human body's microbial ecosystem another domain for optimization and inequality. Upper-tier individuals carry engineered microbiomes that protect them from food-borne illness, optimize their nutrition absorption, and enhance their cognitive performance through gut-brain signaling. Lower-tier individuals carry whatever microbes they have acquired naturally. The biological divide is invisible but measurable — people with engineered microbiomes are statistically healthier, sharper, and more resilient.
Properties.story_hooks: A MEP microbiome package designed for a corporate executive has been found to include organisms that produce a compound making the host more suggestible — someone is using microbiome engineering for behavioral modification.; An engineered microbiome has become transferable between people through close contact — the optimization organisms are spreading naturally, but without the customization that made them safe for the original host.

Nodes.Name: Enhanced immune function through engineered flora
Superhuman strength within biological skeletal load limits
Sustained high-output physical labor without fatigue degradation
Covert augmentation undetectable by standard biometric scanning
Helix Biosystems Neural Tissue Regeneration Protocol

Properties.description: A medical procedure that stimulates the regeneration of damaged neural tissue in the brain and spinal cord, restoring function lost to injury, stroke, or degenerative disease. The NTRP uses a combination of growth factor infusions, scaffold protein injections, and electrical stimulation patterns to coax adult neural stem cells into differentiating and forming new connections. The protocol can restore motor function to paralyzed limbs, repair cognitive deficits from traumatic brain injury, and reverse early-stage neurodegenerative conditions. Treatment takes 3-6 months and requires careful monitoring to ensure new neural growth follows functional pathways.
Properties.aliases: NTRP, Brain Repair, Neuro Regrow, Helix Restore
Properties.social_impact: NTRP has made neural damage reversible for the first time, but the treatment's cost (Φ500,000+) and 3-6 month duration limit access to those with resources and time. The technology has also created uncomfortable questions about criminal rehabilitation — if brain damage contributed to violent behavior, and that damage is now repairable, is there an obligation to treat rather than punish? Courts have begun ordering NTRP evaluations for convicted violent offenders, opening a legal battleground between rehabilitation advocates and punitive justice proponents.
Properties.story_hooks: An NTRP patient's regenerating neural tissue has formed connections that do not match normal human brain architecture — the new neural growth is functional but organized in a pattern that neuroscientists cannot explain, and the patient is exhibiting capabilities that no human brain should have.; A black market NTRP clinic is offering the treatment at 1/10th the cost using an accelerated protocol — patients recover faster but some are experiencing personality changes as the rapid neural growth forms connections that override existing personality patterns.

Nodes.Name: Electrical stimulation patterning for neural guidance
Reversal of paralysis from spinal cord injury
axonal regeneration after traumatic brain injury
Helix Biosystems OculaRegen CR-5 Corneal Reconstruction Film

Properties.description:
The OculaRegen CR-5 is a single-use bioengineered corneal reconstruction film developed by Helix Biosystems for treating traumatic corneal damage, chemical burns, and the increasingly common 'augmentation erosion' syndrome caused by poorly fitted optical implants degrading the host corneal tissue. The CR-5 consists of a 0.1mm amniotic membrane analog layered with corneal epithelial stem cell precursors and a dissolvable photopolymer scaffold that maintains precise curvature geometry during the initial 72-hour adhesion window. The film is applied directly to the debrided corneal surface under local anesthetic in a procedure taking under 15 minutes, requiring no sutures — the photopolymer scaffold bonds to residual stromal tissue via UV-activated adhesion chemistry and then slowly transfers structural load to the growing epithelium before fully dissolving over 3–5 days.

The CR-5's most significant technical advancement over predecessor products like the CR-3 and competing films from Novafold is its incorporation of a gradient refractive index layer within the photopolymer scaffold, allowing the film to simultaneously correct moderate refractive errors during the healing period. Patients with corneal damage frequently experience severe uncorrected vision during recovery; the CR-5 effectively serves as a therapeutic contact lens and regenerative scaffold simultaneously. The stem cell precursor layer is derived from a proprietary Helix Biosystems allogeneic cell line, meaning the product requires no donor matching and can be deployed from standard refrigerated storage with a 6-month shelf life.

In Meridian 88's context of widespread optical augmentation, the CR-5 has become the standard of care for managing what the medical community calls 'implant aftermath' — the ocular surface damage left behind when optical augments are removed, fail, or are forcibly extracted. Ripperdocs performing unauthorized augment extractions rely heavily on CR-5 films obtained through gray-market channels, and Helix Biosystems has an active (if poorly enforced) diversion-monitoring program tracking serial numbers.
Properties.social_impact: The OculaRegen CR-5 has enabled a secondary economy around optical augmentation cycling — the knowledge that corneal damage is repairable has accelerated the culture of frequent optical augment upgrades among those who can afford it, while simultaneously creating a massive demand for gray-market CR-5 supplies in lower tiers where augmentation removal (voluntary or forced) is common. Extraction gangs that forcibly remove optical implants for resale depend on CR-5 availability to keep victims functional enough that the crime goes unreported, creating a grim feedback loop between the product's availability and a specific category of augmentation violence.
Properties.story_hooks: A series of corneal reconstruction failures in Tier 3 has been traced to counterfeit CR-5 films with non-viable stem cell layers — someone is manufacturing convincing fakes and the victims are going permanently blind; Helix Biosystems' serial number tracking program has identified a ripperdoc using an unusually high volume of CR-5 films — the investigators find evidence of a forced extraction operation, but the ripperdoc claims she's treating victims, not enabling perpetrators; A corporate executive's vision was permanently damaged by a CR-5 from a contaminated batch; she wants to know if it was an accident or sabotage, and by whom; A researcher contacts the party claiming to have developed a permanent CR-5 variant that doesn't require the Helix stem cell line — Helix Biosystems will pay extremely well for that research to disappear
