Neural augmentation installation in previously damaged limbs
Zheng-Dao Bioelectric OsteoMatrix Flex-3 Bone Regeneration Scaffold

Properties.description:
The OsteoMatrix Flex-3 is a bioelectric bone regeneration scaffold system consisting of a patient-customized porous titanium-ceramic lattice printed to match the geometry of the damaged skeletal region, embedded with Zheng-Dao's proprietary piezoelectric microfilaments. These filaments generate micro-electrical fields in response to mechanical loading — mimicking the natural bioelectric signals that govern osteoblast activity — and accelerate bone ingrowth into the scaffold structure at rates 3.2x faster than passive scaffold competitors. The Flex-3 designation refers to the third-generation flexible integration zones at the scaffold's margins, which use a graduated porosity gradient to prevent the stress-shielding fractures that plagued rigid-margin earlier models. The scaffold is designed to be fully resorbed by host bone tissue over 18-24 months, leaving no permanent implant material.

The manufacturing process requires a pre-procedure CT scan fed into Zheng-Dao's cloud fabrication system, which produces the customized scaffold within 6 hours using sintered ceramic-titanium powder beds. This tight turnaround has made the OsteoMatrix system viable for trauma applications, not just elective reconstructive surgery. The embedded piezoelectric network also serves a secondary diagnostic function: an external wand reader (the ZD OsteoScan RS-2) can interrogate the scaffold's electrical output pattern to assess bone ingrowth progress non-invasively, replacing the need for follow-up imaging in most cases.

The OsteoMatrix Flex-3 has found a significant secondary market in Meridian 88's augmentation-adjacent economy. Citizens who require skeletal reinforcement to support heavy cybernetic limb attachments — where the bone-implant interface is a chronic failure point — use the Flex-3 scaffold to pre-strengthen attachment sites before augmentation surgery. Zheng-Dao markets this application through licensed augmentation clinics but quietly ignores its use in unlicensed chop-shop pre-augmentation prep.
Properties.aliases: BoneGrid, Flex-Three, The Lattice, ZD Scaffold
Properties.social_impact: The OsteoMatrix Flex-3 has quietly become a prerequisite technology for the heavy augmentation market in Meridian 88. As corporations push employees toward heavier, more capable cybernetic limb systems for industrial and security work, skeletal failure at attachment points has become a recognized occupational injury category. Workers in Tier 3 industrial contracts who receive employer-mandated augmentation without accompanying skeletal reinforcement — because the scaffold adds cost the employer won't absorb — face a documented pattern of interface fractures within 3-5 years, creating a cycle of medical debt and re-injury that keeps augmented industrial workers economically dependent on their corporate employers.
Properties.story_hooks: A labor organizer in the Palladian Construction workforce has compiled records showing that the company's medical contractors systematically omit OsteoMatrix scaffolding from worker augmentation packages despite internal safety assessments recommending it — she needs someone to get those internal documents out before the next contract renewal; A counterfeiting ring has been producing OsteoMatrix Flex-3 scaffolds using incorrect piezoelectric filament specifications — the scaffolds look identical but generate fields that inhibit rather than promote bone growth, and the first wave of patients is beginning to present with catastrophic scaffold failures; Zheng-Dao's cloud fabrication system for the OsteoMatrix has been compromised — someone has been inserting microscopic structural weaknesses into scaffolds destined for specific patients, and the modifications are subtle enough that they won't manifest as failure for 18 months

Nodes.Name: Zheng-Dao Bioelectric PulseGuard CR-2 Cardiac Rhythm Stabilization Implant

Properties.description:
The PulseGuard CR-2 is a subdermal cardiac rhythm management implant roughly the size of a large coin, seated beneath the left clavicle via a 15-minute outpatient procedure. It combines a next-generation adaptive pacemaker with a bioelectric defibrillation module capable of delivering a precisely calibrated shock to terminate ventricular fibrillation without the energy demands that made earlier implanted defibrillators bulky and short-lived. The CR-2 harvests a portion of its operating power from the body's own bioelectric gradient using Zheng-Dao's established microcurrent harvesting architecture, supplemented by a solid-state reserve cell with a projected 12-year lifespan under normal load.

What distinguishes the CR-2 from legacy cardiac implants is its real-time arrhythmia classification engine — a compact neuromorphic processing unit that continuously analyzes cardiac waveforms and distinguishes between benign rhythm variations (common in heavily augmented individuals whose implants introduce bioelectric interference) and genuinely dangerous arrhythmias requiring intervention. This dramatically reduces inappropriate shock delivery, which had been a leading cause of augmentation-related cardiac injury in Meridian 88's densely wired population. The device communicates with Saltmarsh Telecom's health monitoring infrastructure when in range, forwarding anonymized rhythm data to Zheng-Dao's cardiac analytics network.

The CR-2 is standard issue for any citizen receiving thoracic augmentation above a certain implant density threshold, and Tier 1 corporate employees frequently receive it as a proactive measure regardless of cardiac history. In lower tiers, access is more complicated — the device is theoretically available through subsidized Tier 3 health programs, but waiting lists run 18 months or longer, and counterfeit units using inferior capacitor arrays have caused several documented deaths by delayed defibrillation. A persistent rumor in security circles holds that the CR-2's Saltmarsh data uplink can be exploited to deliver a targeted cardiac event — a claim Zheng-Dao dismisses as technically impossible and Arcturus Defense Solutions has reportedly been investigating for three years.
Properties.aliases: The Ticker, CR-2, HeartLock, Zheng Pulse
Properties.tier_availability: Tier 1–2 (standard issue); Tier 3 (subsidized waitlist); Grey market Tier 4+
Properties.social_impact: The PulseGuard CR-2 has created a sharp and visible divide in Meridian 88's augmented population: those whose hearts are managed by a corporate device with a live uplink to Zheng-Dao's servers, and those who either can't afford the implant or refuse it on principle. The data uplink controversy has fed a growing anti-telemetry movement in the lower tiers, where 'going dark' — removing or blocking health monitoring implants — is simultaneously a political statement, a survival strategy against corporate surveillance, and a genuine medical risk. For the corporations, the CR-2 network represents one of the most intimate datasets they hold: the literal heartbeats of their workforce, in real time.
Properties.story_hooks: Three senior executives from competing corporations have died of sudden cardiac arrest within a week — all had CR-2 implants, and the rhythm logs show identical anomalous signatures 30 seconds before each event; A Zheng-Dao data engineer approaches the players with evidence that the CR-2 uplink is being used to build a 'kill list' of high-value targets — and their own name is on it; A counterfeit CR-2 manufacturer in the Port District is producing units that look identical to legitimate devices but have a 40% failure rate on defibrillation — someone needs to find the supply chain before more people die; The players must keep a critically ill contact alive long enough to testify, but their contact's CR-2 has been remotely flagged for 'maintenance mode' — effectively disabling the defibrillation function

Nodes.Name: Bioelectric interference mapping in augmented populations
Persistent memory indexing and recall augmentation
Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Asteroid Mining Operations

Properties.description: A space-based mining program that captures near-Earth asteroids and processes them in orbit for mineral resources, using the space elevator to transport refined materials to the surface. Zheng-Dao's asteroid mining operations target metallic asteroids containing platinum group metals, rare earth elements, and iron-nickel alloys in quantities that dwarf terrestrial reserves. A single captured asteroid can contain more platinum than has been mined in all of human history, and the operational costs are justified by the extraordinary concentration of valuable materials.
Properties.aliases: AMO, Space Mine, Rock Grab, Zheng-Dao Asteroid
Properties.social_impact: Asteroid mining has the potential to make every terrestrial mineral resource irrelevant — a single successful capture operation delivers more material than decades of conventional mining. This potential has created both extraordinary corporate value for Zheng-Dao and existential anxiety for the terrestrial mining industry, including Dredge Mining Collective. The first successful large-scale asteroid mineral delivery will crash commodity prices globally and reshape the economics of material production.
Properties.story_hooks: Zheng-Dao's first major asteroid capture is approaching processing completion — the asteroid contains an estimated 500 years' worth of global platinum supply, and its arrival on the surface will destroy the platinum market overnight.; An asteroid capture operation has gone wrong — the captured asteroid is in a degrading orbit and Zheng-Dao is scrambling to determine whether it will be processed in time or become an extinction-level impact threat.

Nodes.Name: Practically unlimited mineral supply from space
Platinum group metals in orbital quantities
Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Directed Seismic Control Array

Properties.description: A system of deep-buried resonance generators that can create, dampen, or redirect seismic activity within a controlled area. The DSCA uses phased arrays of underground acoustic emitters to generate constructive or destructive interference patterns in geological strata, either amplifying natural seismic activity into damaging earthquakes or canceling incoming seismic waves to protect structures. Zheng-Dao developed the technology for earthquake defense but its offensive applications — the ability to cause earthquakes on demand — have obvious military implications.
Properties.aliases: DSCA, Quake Box, Earth Mover, Zheng-Dao Tremor
Properties.social_impact: The DSCA has given Zheng-Dao the ability to control earthquakes — to cause them, prevent them, or redirect them. This capability is a strategic deterrent comparable to nuclear weapons in its implications: the threat of seismic destruction can be used to coerce compliance without ever being deployed. Meridian 88's population lives on ground that Zheng-Dao can, theoretically, shake apart at will.
Properties.story_hooks: A series of minor earthquakes in a Tier 2 district match the resonance signature of DSCA activity — someone is using seismic control to send a message or test the system's capabilities in an urban area.; A DSCA installation has been discovered to be counteracting natural seismic activity that would otherwise have caused a major earthquake — Zheng-Dao has been quietly preventing natural disasters and not telling anyone, building leverage for future negotiations.

Nodes.Name: Seismic wave cancellation for structure protection
Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Graviton Manipulation Framework

Properties.description: The foundational technology behind Zheng-Dao's gravity manipulation weapons and industrial systems. The GMF uses arrays of superconducting graviton emitters cooled to near absolute zero to generate and direct localized gravitational fields. The framework enables the creation of gravity wells, repulsion fields, and gravitational lensing effects within a contained area. Current implementation requires massive power input and cryogenic infrastructure, limiting the technology to vehicle-mounted or facility-based systems, but Zheng-Dao's roadmap projects man-portable graviton manipulation within a decade.
Properties.aliases: GMF, Gravity Tech, G-Frame, Zheng-Dao Gravity
Properties.social_impact: The existence of practical gravity manipulation has shattered fundamental assumptions about physics-based limitations in engineering, architecture, and warfare. Zheng-Dao's monopoly on the technology gives them leverage that transcends conventional corporate competition — they can literally change the rules of physics within their operational sphere. Other corponations are investing heavily in alternative approaches, but Zheng-Dao's 15-year head start in graviton emitter fabrication creates a moat that may be insurmountable.
Properties.story_hooks: A Zheng-Dao graviton emitter prototype has been stolen and the thief does not understand the cryogenic requirements — the emitter is warming up and when it reaches critical temperature, the gravitational field it is generating will collapse catastrophically.; A physicist outside Zheng-Dao has independently derived the mathematics for graviton manipulation and published them openly — Zheng-Dao's monopoly is threatened and they are willing to do anything to suppress the work.

Nodes.Name: Kinetic energy weapons through gravity acceleration
Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Hypersonic Scramjet Transport

Properties.description: A hypersonic air transport system using scramjet engines that cruise at Mach 8+, reducing intercontinental travel times to under 90 minutes. The vehicles fly at altitudes above 30 kilometers, entering the upper atmosphere where air resistance is minimal and the scramjet engines achieve maximum efficiency. Zheng-Dao operates a fleet of HST vehicles for executive transport, high-priority cargo delivery, and rapid force deployment, connecting Meridian 88 to global destinations faster than any conventional aircraft. The vehicles are not weapons platforms, but their speed makes them effectively immune to interception by anything except other hypersonic systems.
Properties.aliases: HST, Speed Bird, Zheng-Dao Express, Mach Rider
Properties.social_impact: HST has shrunk the world for those who can afford it — Zheng-Dao executives attend meetings on different continents within the same business day. This global reach amplifies the power of corporations that operate HST fleets, allowing real-time physical presence anywhere on Earth. The technology has also raised concerns about the use of hypersonic platforms as kinetic weapons — a vehicle traveling at Mach 8 does not need explosive ordnance to be devastating on impact.
Properties.story_hooks: A Zheng-Dao HST has gone off-course during a routine flight and is heading toward a population center at Mach 8 — whether it is a malfunction, a hijacking, or an attack, the 90-second response window is already closing.; Someone has developed a method to track HST flights that Zheng-Dao believed were undetectable — the flight data reveals patterns of executive travel that expose corporate strategy to competitors.

Nodes.Name: High-priority cargo delivery at unprecedented speed
Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Magnetic Levitation Urban Transit

Properties.description: A surface-level magnetic levitation transit system that moves passenger pods at 300 km/h through elevated guideways above Meridian 88's streets. The MLUT uses superconducting magnetic levitation to eliminate friction, enabling silent, energy-efficient high-speed urban transit. The elevated guideways run above existing infrastructure, requiring no surface footprint beyond support pylons. Zheng-Dao operates the system as a premium transit option connecting major commercial and residential hubs in the upper tiers.
Properties.aliases: MLUT, Mag Rail, Sky Train, Zheng-Dao Rail
Properties.social_impact: The MLUT has created a visible striation of mobility privilege — elevated guideways carrying upper-tier residents at 300 km/h pass directly over lower-tier streets where people walk or use improvised vehicles. The physical overhead presence of high-speed transit that lower tiers cannot access is a daily reminder of economic stratification, and the guideway pylons have become canvases for protest art and territorial marking.
Properties.story_hooks: An MLUT pod was sabotaged to derail at speed — the magnetic levitation failure sent the pod through the guideway barrier and into a lower-tier market, killing fourteen people.; Someone has found a way to hack MLUT pod navigation and redirect pods to unauthorized stops — a ghost station in an abandoned section of guideway that does not appear on any transit map.

Nodes.Name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Orbital Manufacturing Platform

Properties.description: A modular space station in low Earth orbit dedicated to manufacturing processes that benefit from microgravity and vacuum conditions. The OMP produces materials and components that are impossible to fabricate in planetary gravity — perfect crystal structures, flawless optical fibers, exotic alloys that separate by density on Earth but mix perfectly in microgravity, and biological structures that grow without gravitational distortion. The platform receives raw materials via the space elevator and returns finished products to the surface. Zheng-Dao operates the OMP as a restricted manufacturing facility, producing components whose quality cannot be matched by any ground-based process.
Properties.aliases: OMP, Space Forge, Zero-G Factory, Orbital Works
Properties.social_impact: OMP-manufactured products represent the absolute pinnacle of material quality and command prices that reflect their orbital origin. Neural interface components, optical systems, and exotic materials that require microgravity fabrication are available only from Zheng-Dao, and the space elevator monopoly ensures no competitor can access orbit to establish rival manufacturing. The OMP has become a strategic asset that Zheng-Dao protects with military-grade orbital defense systems.
Properties.story_hooks: The OMP has experienced a containment breach in its biological manufacturing wing — the organisms being grown in microgravity have been released into the station's atmosphere and are adapting to the orbital environment in unexpected ways.; A saboteur aboard the OMP has introduced defects into a production run of neural interface components — thousands of compromised units are being shipped down the space elevator and distributed across Meridian 88.

Nodes.Name: Biological structure development without gravitational distortion
Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Space Elevator Tether System

Properties.description: A carbon nanotube tether extending from a ground anchor near Meridian 88 to a counterweight in geostationary orbit, enabling the transport of cargo and personnel to space without rocket propulsion. The tether carries electromagnetic climber vehicles that ascend to orbit in 8 hours, reducing the cost of space access by a factor of 100 compared to conventional launch systems. Zheng-Dao constructed the space elevator over a 12-year period using materials fabricated in orbit and lowered to the surface, and it is now the primary conduit for off-world resource transport, orbital manufacturing, and access to Zheng-Dao's growing orbital infrastructure.
Properties.aliases: SETS, Sky Rope, Zheng-Dao Ladder, Orbit Bridge
Properties.social_impact: The space elevator has given Zheng-Dao a monopoly on orbital access from Meridian 88's region, and they leverage this monopoly aggressively. Any entity that wants to access space — for manufacturing, resource exploitation, or simply to escape Earth's jurisdiction — must negotiate with Zheng-Dao. The elevator's ground anchor is one of the most heavily defended installations in Meridian 88, as its destruction would strand orbital assets and end space access for decades. The tether itself is a vulnerability — a clean cut at any point would cause catastrophic recoil.
Properties.story_hooks: Intelligence suggests a faction is planning to sever the space elevator tether — the resulting recoil would whip thousands of kilometers of carbon nanotube across the surface like a planet-sized wire saw.; Zheng-Dao has been quietly transporting something down the elevator that they are not declaring on cargo manifests — the climber vehicles are arriving heavier than they should be, and the ground facility has increased security.

Nodes.Name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Subterranean Transit Network

Properties.description: A network of high-speed transit tubes buried 200-500 meters beneath Meridian 88's surface, using magnetic levitation and vacuum sealing to propel passenger and cargo pods at speeds exceeding 1,000 km/h. The STN connects major corporate facilities, government installations, and upper-tier residential districts through a transportation system that bypasses surface congestion entirely. The tunnels were excavated by DEAES autonomous boring systems and lined with reinforced materials capable of withstanding the geological pressures at depth. The network is invisible from the surface — most Meridian 88 residents do not know it exists.
Properties.aliases: STN, Undergrid, Mole Rail, Deep Transit
Properties.social_impact: The STN represents a literal underground layer of privilege — a transportation system that only the powerful know about and only the authorized can access. Its existence means that corporate executives and high-tier residents can move between facilities without ever appearing on surface surveillance, creating a shadow geography of movement that is invisible to the broader population. The STN has also enabled covert military logistics, with Zheng-Dao using the network to move weapons and personnel beneath city streets without detection.
Properties.story_hooks: A player character discovers an STN access point in an unexpected location — a forgotten maintenance hatch in a Tier 1 basement that opens onto a high-speed transit tube carrying corporate executives directly beneath the city's poorest district.; Someone has introduced a contaminant into the STN's vacuum system that is being carried through the tube network — every station and pod is being exposed to an unknown substance.

Nodes.Name: Bypass of surface traffic and surveillance
Secure transport of personnel and materials
Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Zero-Point Energy Research Platform

Properties.description: An experimental physics research facility investigating the extraction of usable energy from quantum vacuum fluctuations — the fundamental energy inherent in empty space itself. The ZPERP has demonstrated energy extraction at laboratory scale, producing measurable power output from what appears to be nothing, but the process requires more energy to initiate than it produces in current configurations. Zheng-Dao's research roadmap projects net positive energy extraction within a decade, which would represent a literally infinite energy source. The physics community is divided on whether the research is groundbreaking or a measurement error.
Properties.aliases: ZPERP, Vacuum Tap, Zero Point, Zheng-Dao Infinity
Properties.social_impact: The ZPERP represents either the most important physics discovery in human history or an extremely expensive measurement error, and the distinction has multi-trillion-credit implications. If zero-point energy extraction becomes viable, every existing energy technology — fusion, solar, geothermal — becomes obsolete overnight. Ouroboros Energy, Zheng-Dao's energy competitor, has invested heavily in discrediting the research while simultaneously pursuing their own zero-point program in secret.
Properties.story_hooks: The ZPERP has achieved net positive energy extraction in a single test run — the result has been classified immediately, and the research team has been isolated from outside contact.; A ZPERP experiment produced an unexpected side effect — a localized region of space where physical constants appear to be slightly different from normal, suggesting that manipulating vacuum energy alters the fabric of reality.

Nodes.Name: Potential infinite energy extraction from vacuum
Physics paradigm shift in energy production

who's decided to be unreadable.

fought in pigment and blood and claw-marks. Every mural is an act

and understood that the old man was somewhere else entirely — a place with different weather and

down first. She never explains why the menu changed that day.

troubles. People tell her things over noodles they wouldn't tell a priest or a therapist. She files
it all away, never gossips, and deploys information only when someone's safety depends on it. She's
the central nervous system of the Shelf, and she'd be furious if anyone described her that way.

The tattoo. The file. The thirty-seven minutes every morning.

Axiom is her world. It gave her augments, a career, a clean apartment, a locked door, and a
purpose that doesn't require her to ask difficult questions as long as she doesn't look too
closely at the answers. It also systematically grinds the communities she came from — places
like the Shelf — under its operational requirements. She knows both things. She keeps them in
separate compartments and never lets them meet.

Her father died when she was fourteen — a workplace accident at the docks that Axiom classified
as "operator error" to avoid liability. Her mother died three years later, worn through by
double shifts at an understaffed clinic. Yuki enlisted within months. She never says their
names. She sends money to maintain their graves on the Shelf, through an anonymous account,
because going in person would mean seeing what she left.
